qe: In whose royal court did the eight celebrated Telugu poets known as 'Ashtadiggajas' reside?
qh: 'अष्टदिग्गज' किस प्रसिद्ध राजा के दरबार में रहते थे?
e: Vijayanagara ke Tuluva dynasty ke famous king Krishnadeva Raya ke court me Telugu literature ke 8 mahan scholars aur poets rehte the, jinhe Ashtadiggajas kaha jata tha.

qe: Approximately what percentage of India's population lived in rural villages during the 16th and 17th centuries?
qh: 16वीं-17वीं शताब्दी के दौरान हिंदुस्तान की लगभग कितनी प्रतिशत आबादी गाँवों में रहती थी?
e: Mughal period ke dauran lagbhag 85% population gaon me rehti thi aur directly ya indirectly agriculture par depend karti thi.

qe: Which term was predominantly used to designate a peasant in Indo-Persian historical sources of the Mughal period?
qh: मुगल काल में भारतीय-फारसी स्रोतों में किसान के लिए अक्सर किस शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता था?
e: Indo-Persian records me kisan ke liye 'Raiyat' (plural: Riaya) ya 'Muzarian' aur 'Kisan' terms use kiye jaate the.

qe: In Mughal agrarian society, who were designated as 'Khud-kashta' peasants?
qh: 'खुद-कास्त' (Khud-kashta) किसान किन्हें कहा जाता था?
o: Peasants who cultivated lands in other villages on contract
Residents who cultivated their own personal lands within their native village
Forest dwellers engaged in shifting cultivation
Revenue collectors appointed by the crown
e: Khud-kashta wo resident cultivators the jo usi gaon me rehte the jahan unki apni zameen hoti thi aur wahi kheti karte the.

qe: What were the non-resident peasants who cultivated lands in other villages on a contractual basis called?
qh: वे किसान जो दूसरे गाँवों में ठेके पर खेती करने जाते थे, क्या कहलाते थे?
e: Pahi-kashta nonresident ya migrant peasants the jo revenue concessions ya distress ke chalte doosre gaon jakar contract par kheti karte the.

qe: Which comprehensive administrative account of Akbar's reign was authored by his court historian Abul Fazl?
qh: मुगल सम्राट अकबर के दरबारी इतिहासकार अबुल फजल द्वारा लिखित प्रसिद्ध ग्रंथ का नाम क्या है?
e: Ain-i-Akbari Akbarnama ka third volume hai jisme Akbar ke administration, army, revenue aur agriculture ka systematic data diya gaya hai.

qe: What did the term 'Jins-i-Kamil' denote in the Mughal agricultural revenue administration?
qh: मुगल काल में 'जिन्स-ए-कामिल' (Jins-i-Kamil) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: High-value cash crops yielding superior revenue
e: Jins-i-Kamil ka literal meaning 'perfect crops' tha; ye cotton, sugarcane aur oilseeds jaise cash crops the jinse state ko higher tax milta tha.

qe: What were the three foundational constituents of the rural community in Mughal India?
qh: मुगल काल में ग्रामीण समुदाय के तीन मुख्य घटक कौन से थे?
o: Cultivators, village panchayat, and village headman
Merchants, urban artisans, and foreign travelers
e: Mughal village community me teen main components the: actual peasants (kisan), village panchayat aur gaon ka headman (Muqaddam/Mandal).

qe: What title was given to the village headman who presided over the rural panchayat in Mughal times?
qh: गाँव की पंचायत के मुखिया को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Village panchayat ke chief ko Muqaddam ya Mandal kehte the, jiska election gaon ke elders ki aapsi sehmati se hota tha.

qe: What was the primary civic responsibility of the village panchayat during the Mughal period?
qh: मुगल काल में 'पंचायत' का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
o: Managing community funds, dispensing local justice, and enforcing caste boundaries
Settling foreign immigrants in crown lands
e: Panchayat village welfare fund (kasan) manage karti thi, aapsi disputes settle karti thi aur ensure karti thi ki log caste rules break na karein.

qe: In Mughal-era customary property arrangements, what was meant by 'Stridhan'?
qh: मुगलकालीन समाज में महिलाओं की स्थिति के संदर्भ में 'स्त्रीधन' क्या था?
o: Assets and jewelry received by a woman at marriage over which she held ownership
Name of a women's village council
e: Stridhan wo property, cash ya ornaments the jo aurat ko marriage ke waqt gifts ke roop me milte the aur uspe uska exclusive right hota tha.

qe: Which crop was introduced into Indian agriculture in the 17th century via Africa and Spain?
qh: किस फसल को भारत में 17वीं सदी में अफ्रीका और स्पेन के रास्ते लाया गया था?
e: Maize (makka) New World se Spain aur Africa hote hue 17th century me India introduce hua aur western parts me major staple bana.

qe: How were the 'Zamindars' socially and economically positioned in the Mughal Empire?
qh: मुगल काल में 'जमींदार' कौन थे?
o: Peasants who cultivated common village plots
Landed gentry possessing private landholdings and enjoying high social standing
e: Zamindars landed elites the jinki apni personal zameen (milkiyat) hoti thi aur wo state ke behalf par peasants se land revenue collect karte the.

qe: In the Mughal land revenue vocabulary, what did the term 'Jama' represent?
qh: मुगल राजस्व प्रणाली में 'जमा' (Jama) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Total assessed revenue amount determined by the state
e: Jama wo total revenue amount thi jo state officials assessment ke baad fix karte the ki itna tax aana chahiye.

qe: In Mughal fiscal terminology, what was the actual revenue realized and collected called?
qh: मुगल राजस्व प्रणाली में वास्तव में वसूली गई रकम को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Assessed revenue ko 'Jama' kehte the jabki jo amount ground reality me actually collect hoti thi use 'Hasil' kaha jata tha.

qe: Which imperial revenue official was entrusted with the direct collection of agricultural taxes in a sarkar or pargana?
qh: राजस्व वसूली का काम करने वाले अधिकारी को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Amil-guzar pargana level ka main revenue collection officer tha jiska primary task cultivators se cash ya crop me tax collect karna tha.

qe: The massive influx of bullion via maritime trade during the Mughal era caused which metal's currency to become ubiquitous?
qh: चांदी के बहाव के कारण मुगल काल में किस धातु के रुपयों का प्रचलन बढ़ गया?
e: Global trade ke badhne se Europe se silver India enter hua, jisse Mughal silver rupee currency standard aur widely circulated bana.

qe: Which aspect of administration is detailed in the 'Manzil-abadi' book of the Ain-i-Akbari?
qh: आईन-ए-अकबरी के 'मंजिल-आबादी' (Manzil-abadi) भाग में क्या वर्णित है?
o: The imperial household, palace establishment, and royal maintenance
e: Ain-i-Akbari ka pehla daftaar 'Manzil-abadi' imperial harem, royal mint, kitchen aur royal household management se deal karta hai.

qe: What subject matter is covered under the 'Sipah-abadi' book of the Ain-i-Akbari?
qh: आईन-ए-अकबरी के 'सिपह-आबादी' (Sipah-abadi) भाग का संबंध किससे है?
o: Military and civil administration, including noble ranks and royal servants
e: Ain-i-Akbari ka second book 'Sipah-abadi' military organization, mansabdars aur civil bureaucratic appointments ko cover karta hai.

qe: What was the overarching administrative portfolio of the 'Diwan' in the Mughal imperial setup?
qh: मुगल काल में 'दीवान' की मुख्य जिम्मेदारी क्या थी?
o: Supreme command of imperial battlefield infantry
Oversight of imperial revenue collection and fiscal state management
e: Diwan empire ka finance minister aur supreme revenue authority hota tha jo revenue assessments aur expenditure monitor karta tha.

qe: In the Ahom kingdom of Assam, what were the subjects obligated to render compulsory military and labour service called?
qh: असम के वे लोग जिन्हें जमीन के बदले सैनिक सेवा देनी होती थी, क्या कहलाते थे?
e: Ahom administration me Paiks wo male subjects the jo state ke liye rotational base par compulsory public works aur military service provide karte the.

qe: Into how many administrative books (daftars) is the Ain-i-Akbari structurally divided?
qh: आईन-ए-अकबरी में कुल कितनी जिल्दें (किताबें) हैं?
e: Ain-i-Akbari 5 books (daftars) me divided hai: Manzil-abadi, Sipah-abadi, Mulk-abadi aur aakhiri do books religion aur Akbar ke sayings par hain.

qe: In contemporary Mughal records, what term was applied to forest-dwelling tribes who subsisted on hunting and gathering?
qh: गाँव के उस समूह को क्या कहा जाता था जिनका गुजारा जंगल के उत्पादों और शिकार से चलता था?
e: Contemporary Persian sources me forest dwellers ke liye 'Jungli' term use hota tha, jiska matlab unke forest-dependent livelihood se tha.

qe: In which province was the historic 'Shah Nahar' canal repaired and deepened during Shah Jahan's reign?
qh: मुगल काल के दौरान उत्तर भारत में सिंचाई के लिए मरम्मत कराई गई 'शाह नहर' कहाँ स्थित थी?
e: Shah Jahan ke dauran Punjab me Ravi river se nikalne wali 'Shah Nahar' ko repair aur extend kiya gaya tha taaki canal irrigation promote ho sake.

qe: What constituted the primary source of wealth and economic dominance for Mughal-era Zamindars?
qh: जमींदारों की समृद्धि का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: Vast private demesne lands known as 'Milkiyat' cultivated by hired labourers
Exclusive control over coastal maritime trade
e: Zamindars ki personal ownership wali private lands ko 'Milkiyat' kaha jata tha, jise wo hired labour ya sharecroppers se cultivate karate the.

qe: From which geographical territory were tomatoes, potatoes, and chilies imported into India in the 17th century?
qh: 17वीं शताब्दी में आलू, टमाटर और मिर्च कहाँ से भारत आए थे?
e: Columbian exchange ke under Portuguese traders ne New World (Americas) se potatoes, tomatoes aur red chilies India me introduce kiye.

qe: In which book of the Ain-i-Akbari are Emperor Akbar's philosophical maxims and wise sayings compiled?
qh: आईन-ए-अकबरी के किस भाग में अकबर के 'शुभ वचन' संकलित हैं?
e: Ain-i-Akbari ke 5th book me Akbar ke personal philosophical sayings, moral teachings aur administrative observations ko preserve kiya gaya hai.

qe: Which regional province of Mughal India was noted for extensive judicial settlements through influential caste panchayats?
qh: मुगल काल में जाति पंचायतों के संदर्भ में कौन सा राज्य विवादों के निपटारे के लिए प्रसिद्ध था?
e: Rajasthan ke local records (arhsattas) show karte hain ki wahan Jati Panchayats land disputes, marriage aur caste rituals ko strongly govern karti thi.

qe: According to medieval records, artisans often comprised up to what proportion of total households in certain villages?
qh: गाँव में दस्तकारों (शिल्पकारों) की संख्या कितनी प्रतिशत तक हो सकती थी?
e: 17th-century Maratha aur western records show karte hain ki agricultural services dene wale artisans (blacksmiths, carpenters, potters) 25% households tak form karte the.

qe: Which province of the Mughal Empire was world-renowned for its extensive sugarcane cultivation and fine sugar production?
qh: मुगल काल में कौन सा क्षेत्र 'चीनी' (Sugar) के उत्पादन के लिए सबसे प्रसिद्ध था?
e: Mughal era me Bengal high-grade white sugar aur gur ke production ka sabse largest exporter tha jo domestic aur overseas markets me supply hota tha.

qe: How many times did court historian Abul Fazl painstakingly revise the draft text of the Ain-i-Akbari?
qh: आईन-ए-अकबरी के लेखन में कुल कितनी बार संशोधन (Amendments) किए गए थे?
e: Abul Fazl ne Ain-i-Akbari ke factual data aur administrative accuracy ko maintain karne ke liye pure manuscript ko 5 baar revise kiya tha.

qe: In which year was the Vijayanagara Empire founded by the Sangama brothers Harihara and Bukka?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: Harihara aur Bukka ne 1336 CE me Sage Vidyaranya ki guidance se Tungabhadra river ke bank par Vijayanagara Empire ki foundation rakhi thi.

qe: Which ruined architectural site on the banks of the Tungabhadra River served as the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की राजधानी का क्या नाम था?
e: Vijayanagara Empire ki capital Hampi thi, jiske grand structural ruins Karnataka me Tungabhadra river ke किनारे situated hain.

qe: Which British antiquarian and surveyor brought the ruins of Hampi to modern prominence in 1800?
qh: हम्पी के खंडहरों की खोज सन 1800 में किसने की थी?
e: Colonel Colin Mackenzie ne 1800 me Hampi ke site par survey karke pehla systematic topographic aur architectural map draw kiya tha.

qe: What sovereign title did the rulers of the Vijayanagara Empire adopt for themselves?
qh: विजयनगर के शासक अपने आप को क्या कहकर पुकारते थे?
e: Vijayanagara ke monarchs apne titles me 'Raya' prefix use karte the (jaise Krishnadeva Raya) aur local traditions me 'Hindu Raya Suratrana' bhi kehte the.

qe: Which was the foundational first dynasty that ruled the Vijayanagara Empire from 1336 to 1485?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य का पहला राजवंश कौन सा था?
e: Harihara aur Bukka ne apne father Sangama ke naam par first ruling line 'Sangama Dynasty' shuru ki thi.

qe: To which ruling dynasty did the prominent Vijayanagara emperor Krishnadeva Raya belong?
qh: प्रसिद्ध शासक कृष्णदेव राय किस वंश से संबंधित थे?
e: Krishnadeva Raya (1509-1529 CE) third ruling line Tuluva Dynasty ke sabse illustrious aur successful emperor the.

qe: What did the celebrated 'Ashtadiggajas' at the court of Krishnadeva Raya represent?
qh: कृष्णदेव राय के दरबार में रहने वाले 'अष्टदिग्गज' कौन थे?
o: Eight eminent Telugu poets and scholars
e: Ashtadiggajas Krishnadeva Raya ke court ke 8 premier Telugu poets the, jisme Allasani Peddana aur Tenali Ramakrishna shamil the.

qe: Which classic political treatise on statecraft did Krishnadeva Raya author in the Telugu language?
qh: कृष्णदेव राय ने तेलुगु भाषा में किस प्रसिद्ध ग्रंथ की रचना की?
e: Krishnadeva Raya ne Andal ki story par based Telugu me 'Amuktamalyada' compose ki jisme state governance aur diplomacy ka detailed discourse hai.

qe: Who were the 'Amara-nayakas' within the administrative and military setup of the Vijayanagara Empire?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य में 'अमर-नायक' (Amar-nayakas) कौन थे?
o: Military commanders governing territories assigned by the king
e: Amara-nayaka system Delhi Sultanate ke iqta system se inspired tha jahan military chiefs ko revenue aur troop maintenance ke liye territories di jaati thi.

qe: In which year was the disastrous Battle of Talikota (Rakshasi-Tangadi) fought?
qh: तालीकोटा का युद्ध (राक्षसी-तांगड़ी) किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
e: 23 January 1565 ko Battle of Talikota me Deccan Sultanates (Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar, Bidar) ke combined front ne Vijayanagara army ko crush kar diya tha.

qe: In which century was the extensive Kamalapuram water reservoir constructed in Vijayanagara?
qh: विजयनगर की जल आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करने के लिए 'कमलापुरम जलाशय' का निर्माण किस शताब्दी में हुआ था?
e: 15th century ke shuruat me banwaya gaya Kamalapuram tank agricultural irrigation aur canal ke through Royal Centre ko water supply karta tha.

qe: From which river did the engineering marvel 'Hiriya Canal' draw its perennial water supply?
qh: 'हिरिया नहर' (Hiriya Canal) का पानी कहाँ से लाया जाता था?
e: Hiriya canal Tungabhadra par bane masonry dam se water divert karti thi aur agricultural valley ko irrigate karte hue Sacred aur Urban centres ko connect karti thi.

qe: Which architectural monument in Hampi is globally renowned for its stone monolithic chariot temple?
qh: विजयनगर का कौन सा मंदिर अपनी 'नक्काशीदार रथ' संरचना के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Vitthala Temple complex me Garuda ko dedicated famous monolithic Stone Chariot bana hua hai jo Vijayanagara architecture ka icon hai.

qe: What architectural designation was given to the monumental gateway towers fronting Vijayanagara temples?
qh: विजयनगर में मंदिरों के प्रवेश द्वार को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Temples ke entry par towering gateways banaye jaate the jinhe 'Gopurams' ya royal patronage ke chalte 'Raya Gopurams' kaha jata tha.

qe: From which empire was the diplomatic emissary Abdur Razzaq dispatched to Vijayanagara in the 1440s?
qh: अब्दुल रज्जाक (Abdur Razzaq) किस देश से विजयनगर की यात्रा पर आया था?
e: Persian Timurid ruler Shahrukh ke ambassador Abdur Razzaq ne 1443 me Vijayanagara visit kiya aur city ki concentric 7 fortification walls ki tareef ki.

qe: What monumental ceremonial structure was the 'Mahanavami Dibba' within the Royal Centre of Vijayanagara?
qh: 'महानवमी डिब्बा' (Mahanavami Dibba) क्या था?
o: A massive carved square stone platform used for royal festivals
e: Mahanavami Dibba ek 11,000 sq ft base aur 40 ft uncha stone platform tha jahan Mahanavami (Navratri/Dussehra) par king military parades aur rituals supervise karta tha.

qe: What were the local equestrian merchant guilds engaged in horse trade called in Vijayanagara?
qh: घोड़ों के व्यापारियों को विजयनगर में स्थानीय रूप से क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Local horse merchants ko 'Kudirai Chettis' kaha jata tha, jo Arab aur Portuguese traders se high-quality war horses purchase karte the.

qe: Which Hindu deity was enshrined as the principal divine guardian of the royal dynasty in the Virupaksha Temple?
qh: विजयनगर के 'विरुपाक्ष मंदिर' के मुख्य देवता कौन हैं?
e: Virupaksha Temple Lord Shiva ke localized form Virupaksha ko dedicated tha, aur kings unhi ke guardian authority par order sign karte the.

qe: Which planned suburban town did Krishnadeva Raya establish and dedicate to his mother Nagala Devi?
qh: कृष्णदेव राय ने अपनी माता के नाम पर किस उपनगर की स्थापना की थी?
e: Krishnadeva Raya ne Vijayanagara ke paas apni mother Nagala Devi ke honour me 'Nagalapuram' township establish ki thi.

qe: How many salaried rural officials comprised the institutional 'Ayangar' village governance council?
qh: विजयनगर के ग्रामीण प्रशासन में 'अयंगर' (Ayangars) व्यवस्था में कितने अधिकारी होते थे?
e: Ayangar system me har village ke governance aur revenue account management ke liye 12 hereditary functionaries appoint hote the jinhe tax-free manya lands milti thi.

qe: During the reign of which Vijayanagara monarch did the Italian traveler Nicolo Conti visit the capital around 1420?
qh: इटली का यात्री निकोलो कोंटी विजयनगर किसके शासनकाल में आया था?
e: Italian merchant traveler Nicolo de Conti ne Sangama king Devaraya I ke time 1420 CE me Vijayanagara visit karke city layout describe kiya.

qe: Who served as the chief regent and supreme military commander of Vijayanagara during the Battle of Talikota?
qh: तालीकोटा के युद्ध के समय विजयनगर की सेना का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Puppet king Sadashiva Raya ke dauran de facto ruler Aliya Rama Raya tha jinhone 1565 me Talikota battlefield par army lead ki thi.

qe: According to regional folklore, Mother Goddess Pampa Devi performed ascetic penance to marry which deity?
qh: हम्पी की मातृदेवी 'पंपा देवी' ने किनसे विवाह के लिए घोर तपस्या की थी?
e: Local mythological belief ke mutabik Pampa Devi ne Hemakuta hill par Lord Virupaksha (Shiva) ko pati ke roop me paane ke liye penance kiya tha.

qe: Which regional dynasty ruling coastal Odisha in the 15th century bore the traditional title 'Gajapati'?
qh: 'गजपति' (Gajapati) किस क्षेत्र के शासकों को कहा जाता था?
e: Odisha ke Suryavamsi rulers ko unke massive war elephant fleets ke chalte 'Gajapati' (Lords of Elephants) kaha jata tha.

qe: In which year were the monumental architectural remains of Hampi inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site?
qh: यूनेस्को (UNESCO) ने हम्पी को 'विश्व विरासत स्थल' कब घोषित किया?
e: UNESCO ne Hampi ke ruins ki extraordinary cultural aur architectural value ko dekhte hue use 1986 me World Heritage Site designate kiya.

qe: Who gave the romantic descriptive moniker 'Lotus Mahal' to the pavilion in the Zenana Enclosure?
qh: 'लोटस महल' (Lotus Mahal) का नामकरण किसने किया था?
e: Lotus Mahal ka original functional naam clear nahi hai; 19th-century British visitors ne iske lotus-like recessed arches ko dekhkar 'Lotus Mahal' naam diya.

qe: Which Portuguese chronicler spent extensive time at Vijayanagara during the peak reign of Krishnadeva Raya around 1520?
qh: कृष्णदेव राय के समय कौन सा पुर्तगाली यात्री विजयनगर आया था?
e: Portuguese traveler Domingo Paes 1520-22 ke dauran Vijayanagara aaya aur usne Krishnadeva Raya ke personality aur Mahanavami festival ka eyewitness account likha.

qe: Which language was primarily patronized as the official administrative court language of the Vijayanagara rulers?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की आधिकारिक भाषा कौन सी थी?
e: Vijayanagara me Kannada aur Sanskrit dono prominent the, lekin royal court me literary aur official patronage Telugu language ko sabse zyada mila.

qe: Which final dynasty established its reign from Penukonda and Chandragiri after the catastrophic fall of Hampi in 1565?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य के पतन के बाद कौन सा वंश सत्ता में आया?
e: Talikota war ke baad Tirumala Raya ne 4th dynasty 'Aravidu Dynasty' establish ki jo Penukonda aur Chandragiri se southern parts me rule karti rahi.

qe: Which monarch commissioned the Hazara Rama Temple, famed for sculpted narrative relief panels from the Ramayana?
qh: हजारा राम मंदिर का निर्माण किसने करवाया था?
e: Royal centre me situated Hazara Rama Temple ko Krishnadeva Raya ne banwaya tha jo royal family ka private temple tha aur iski walls par Ramayana ki carvings hain.

qe: Around which historical period did the devotional Bhakti movement formally originate in the Tamil country of South India?
qh: भक्ति आंदोलन की शुरुआत मुख्य रूप से किस शताब्दी में हुई थी?
e: Bhakti movement ki pehli wave 6th-7th century CE me Tamil region me shuru hui jahan Alvars aur Nayanars ne emotional personal devotion preach kiya.

qe: What characterizes the foundational theological belief of 'Saguna Bhakti'?
qh: सगुण भक्ति (Saguna Bhakti) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Devotion to an abstract, unmanifest, formless supreme entity
Devotion centered on anthropomorphic divine incarnations and consecrated idol worship
e: Saguna Bhakti me God ko specific physical form, attributes aur human incarnations (jaise Rama, Krishna, Shiva) me visualize karke murti puja ki jaati hai.

qe: Who stood as a prominent exponent of the 'Nirguna Bhakti' tradition in medieval North India?
qh: निर्गुण भक्ति (Nirguna Bhakti) के प्रमुख संत कौन थे?
e: Kabir aur Guru Nanak Nirguna Bhakti ke leaders the, jinhone murti puja aur caste rituals reject karke formless, attribute-less supreme reality ko maana.

qe: The South Indian 'Nayanar' saint-poets dedicated their ecstatic devotional hymns to which supreme deity?
qh: दक्षिण भारत के 'नयनार' (Nayanars) संत किस देवता के भक्त थे?
e: Nayanars Tamil region ke 63 Shaivite saint-poets the jo Lord Shiva ki devotion me hymns compose karte hue ek temple se doosre travel karte the.

qe: What is the canonical traditional count of the Vaishnavite 'Alvar' saint-poets in early medieval South India?
qh: दक्षिण भारत के 'अलवार' (Alvars) संतों की कुल संख्या कितनी थी?
e: Lord Vishnu ki devotion preach karne wale Alvar saints ki canonical total number 12 thi, jisme Nammalvar aur Andal sabse celebrated the.

qe: Which celebrated female Alvar poetess is reverently titled the 'Meera of the South'?
qh: प्रसिद्ध महिला अलवार संत कौन थी जिसे 'दक्षिण की मीरा' भी कहा जाता है?
e: Andal akele female Alvar saint thi jinhone Lord Vishnu (Ranganatha) ko apna beloved husband maankar passionate devotional poetry compose ki.

qe: Which monumental scriptural compilation of 4,000 Tamil devotional hymns is venerated as the 'Tamil Veda'?
qh: 'नलियरा दिव्य प्रबंधनम' किस भक्ति परंपरा का मुख्य ग्रंथ है?
e: 12 Alvar saints ke 4,000 hymns ko Nathamuni ne 'Nalayira Divya Prabandham' me compile kiya, jise South me 5th Veda ya Tamil Veda ka status prapt hai.

qe: Who spearheaded the egalitarian 'Lingayat' (Virashaiva) socio-religious movement in 12th-century Karnataka?
qh: कर्नाटक में 'लिंगायत' (Lingayat) संप्रदाय की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: Basavanna (aur unke associates Allama Prabhu aur Akka Mahadevi) ne 12th century me caste hierarchy aur ritualism ke khilaf Virashaiva/Lingayat movement launch kiya.

qe: Which pioneering medieval saint is celebrated for transmitting the devotional Bhakti stream from South India to North India?
qh: भक्ति आंदोलन को दक्षिण भारत से उत्तर भारत लाने का श्रेय किसे दिया जाता है?
e: Swami Ramananda ne 14th century me Bhakti tradition ko North India me popularise kiya aur sabhi castes aur women ke liye spiritual doors open kiye.

qe: In which sacred city along the Ganges was the mystic weaver-saint Kabir Das born around 1398?
qh: कबीर दास का जन्म 1398 में किस शहर में हुआ था?
e: Kabir ka birth Varanasi (Kashi) me hua tha aur unka upbringing Neeru aur Neema namak Julaha (Muslim weaver) couple ne kiya tha.

qe: Which primary anthology preserves the verses, sakhis, and ramainis of Saint Kabir?
qh: कबीर की शिक्षाओं और वाणियों का संकलन किस पुस्तक में मिलता है?
e: Kabir Panthis ne Kabir ke authentic teachings, verses aur dohas ko 'Bijak' me compile kiya (jiske mukhya parts Sakhi, Sabad aur Ramaini hain).

qe: At which birthplace in Punjab was Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the revered founder of Sikhism, born in 1469?
qh: सिख धर्म के संस्थापक गुरु नानक देव जी का जन्म कहाँ हुआ था?
e: Guru Nanak ka birth 1469 me Talwandi (modern Nankana Sahib, Pakistan) me hua tha.

qe: Which egalitarian institution of open community dining was institutionalized by Guru Nanak to eradicate caste bias?
qh: गुरु नानक देव जी ने सामाजिक समानता के लिए किस प्रथा की शुरुआत की थी?
e: Guru Nanak ne 'Langar' (free community kitchen) establish kiya jahan rich, poor, high caste aur low caste log bina discrimination ek sath pangat me baithkar khana khate hain.

qe: Whom did the celebrated Rajput mystic-princess Mirabai choose as her spiritual preceptor (Guru)?
qh: मीराबाई के गुरु के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है?
e: Mirabai ne social orthodoxy aur royal conventions ko reject karte hue leather-worker caste se aane wale saint Ravidas ko apna spiritual Guru banaya.

qe: From which religious category of subjects was the discriminatory 'Jizya' tax historically levied under orthodox Islamic rule?
qh: इस्लाम में 'जजिया' (Jizya) कर किससे वसूला जाता था?
e: Jizya ek per-capita tax tha jo non-Muslim subjects (Zimmis) par unki life, property aur military service exemption ke protection ke badle impose hota tha.

qe: Which Arab general first imposed the Jizya tax in the Indian subcontinent after the conquest of Sindh in 712 CE?
qh: भारत में पहली बार जजिया कर किसने लगाया था?
e: 712 CE me Sindh capture karne ke baad Umayyad general Muhammad bin Qasim ne Indian subcontinent me pehli baar Jizya impose kiya tha.

qe: In which landmark year did Mughal Emperor Akbar abrogate the unpopular Jizya tax across his empire?
qh: मुगल सम्राट अकबर ने जजिया कर कब समाप्त किया था?
e: Akbar ne apni policy of universal tolerance (Sulh-i-Kul) ke tahat 1564 CE me Jizya tax ko poori tarah abolish kar diya tha.

qe: Among the Five Pillars of Islam, what religious obligation is designated by the term 'Zakat'?
qh: इस्लाम के 'पाँच सिद्धांतों' में 'जकात' (Zakat) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Mandatory charitable almsgiving for the impoverished
e: Zakat Islam ke five pillars me se ek hai, jisme financially able Muslim apni annual wealth ka lagbhag 2.5% needy aur poor logo ke welfare ke liye donate karta hai.

qe: Which four fundamental doctrinal sources constitute the classical jurisprudence of Islamic 'Shariat'?
qh: 'शरीयत' (Shariat) कानून के चार मुख्य स्तंभ क्या हैं?
e: Islamic law (Shariat) 4 main roots par based hai: Quran (revelation), Hadith (Prophet ke sayings), Ijma (consensus) aur Qiyas (analogical reasoning).

qe: What did the institutional term 'Khanqah' denote within medieval Sufi monasticism?
qh: सूफी परंपरा में 'खानका' (Khanqah) किसे कहा जाता था?
o: A hospice and residential community retreat of Sufi saints and disciples
e: Khanqah Sufi master (Shaikh/Pir) ka residential hospice hota tha jahan disciples rehte the, spiritual practice karte the aur common people advice lene aate the.

qe: Who established the renowned Chishti Sufi order in the Indian subcontinent at Ajmer?
qh: भारत में 'चिश्ती' (Chishti) सिलसिले की शुरुआत किसने की थी?
e: Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti ne 1192 CE me Ajmer (Rajasthan) me settle hokar India me Chishti order ki foundation rakhi.

qe: In the mystic vocabulary of Sufism, what relationship is signified by the pairing of 'Pir' and 'Murid'?
qh: सूफी मत में 'पीर' और 'मुरीद' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: Sufism me spiritual mentor ya guru ko 'Pir' (ya Shaikh) kaha jata hai aur unke under oath lene wale devoted disciple ko 'Murid' kehte hain.

qe: In which historical metropolis is the revered Dargah of the celebrated Chishti saint Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya located?
qh: प्रसिद्ध सूफी संत निजामुद्दीन औलिया की दरगाह कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya (Mehboob-e-Ilahi) ki grand Dargah Ghiyaspur (modern Nizamuddin West, Delhi) me situated hai.

qe: Which celebrated polymath poet and music innovator was the foremost disciple of Hazrat Nizamuddin Auliya?
qh: अमीर खुसरो किस सूफी संत के सबसे प्रिय शिष्य थे?
e: Tuti-e-Hind Amir Khusrau Nizamuddin Auliya ke sabse beloved disciple the; unhone Qawwali aur Hindavi poetry develop ki aur unke passing ke theek agle din unki bhi death hui.

qe: Which venerated Sufi ascetic did Emperor Akbar visit barefoot at Sikri to pray for a royal male heir?
qh: अकबर किस सूफी संत का आशीर्वाद लेने नंगे पैर फतेहपुर सीकरी गया था?
e: Akbar Shaikh Salim Chishti ke blessings lene Sikri gaya tha; unke aashirwad se beta hone par Akbar ne uska naam Prince Salim (Jahangir) rakha tha.

qe: In Sufi theological classification, what does the designation 'Ba-shari'a' mean?
qh: सूफी शब्दावली में 'बसरा' (Ba-shari'a) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Antinomian Sufis who reject Islamic jurisprudence
Sufi orders that strictly conform to and practice formal Shariat law
e: Ba-shari'a un Sufi lineages (jaise Chishtis, Suhrawardis) ko denote karta hai jo formal Islamic law (Shariat) ko fully adhere aur respect karte the.

qe: What is the annual death anniversary celebration of a Sufi saint at his shrine called?
qh: सूफी संत की मृत्यु के बाद मनाए जाने वाले उत्सव को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Sufi tradition me saint ki death ko God ke sath 'union' (spiritual marriage) maana jata hai, isliye death anniversary ko 'Urs' ke roop me celebrate karte hain.

qe: In which landmark year did the tenth Sikh Guru, Guru Gobind Singh Ji, inaugurate the martial Khalsa Panth at Anandpur Sahib?
qh: सिखों के 10वें गुरु, गुरु गोविंद सिंह जी ने 'खालसा पंथ' की स्थापना कब की थी?
e: 1699 CE me Baisakhi ke din Anandpur Sahib me Guru Gobind Singh Ji ne Khalsa Panth banaya aur 'Panj Pyare' ko baptize kiya.

qe: Which famous saint uttered the prophetic retort 'Hunuz Dilli Dur Ast' against Sultan Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq?
qh: 'हनुज दिल्ली दूर अस्त' (अभी दिल्ली बहुत दूर है) यह कथन किसका है?
e: Bengal campaign se laut rahe Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq ne order diya tha ki unke aane se pehle Nizamuddin Auliya Delhi chhod dein, tab saint ne kaha tha 'Hunuz Dilli Dur Ast'.

qe: What does the spiritual meditative practice of 'Zikr' entail in Sufi discipline?
qh: सूफी मत में 'जिक्र' (Zikr) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Repetitive rhythmic chanting and remembrance of divine names of God
e: Zikr Sufi practice hai jisme heart aur mind ko purify karne ke liye God ke divine names aur Quranic phrases ka rhythmic repetition kiya jata hai.

qe: What is a narrative account of personal journeys and observations composed by a foreign traveler called?
qh: विदेशी यात्रियों द्वारा लिखे गए 'यात्रा वृत्तांत' को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Foreign travelers dwara apne travel experiences, route descriptions aur local observations par likhi gayi book ko Travelogue (yatra vrittanta) kehte hain.

qe: In which Central Asian region of Khwarizm (modern Uzbekistan) was the polymath Al-Biruni born in 973 CE?
qh: प्रसिद्ध यात्री अलबरूनी (Al-Biruni) का जन्म कहाँ हुआ था?
e: Al-Biruni 973 CE me Khwarizm (modern-day Uzbekistan) me paida hue the, jo us samay learning aur scholarship ka major center tha.

qe: With which invading conqueror did Al-Biruni arrive in the Indian subcontinent in the 11th century?
qh: अलबरूनी किसके साथ भारत आया था?
e: 1017 CE me Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni ne Khwarizm capture kiya aur Al-Biruni ko apne court me laya, jahan se wo Punjab aur North India aaya.

qe: What is the title of the encyclopedic Arabic treatise on Indian culture, science, and philosophy authored by Al-Biruni?
qh: अलबरूनी द्वारा अरबी भाषा में लिखी गई प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक का नाम क्या है?
e: Al-Biruni ne Arabic me 'Kitab-ul-Hind' (Tahqiq ma li-l-Hind) likhi, jisme 80 chapters me Indian religion, astronomy, math aur customs ka objective analysis hai.

qe: Which three fundamental barriers did Al-Biruni identify as impeding foreign understanding of Indian society?
qh: अलबरूनी ने भारत को समझने में किन तीन बाधाओं (Barriers) का उल्लेख किया है?
o: Sanskrit language, religious divergence, and insular self-absorption
e: Al-Biruni ne likha ki Sanskrit ki linguistic complexity, fundamental religious differences aur local scholars ka insular pride unhe samajhne me 3 main barriers the.

qe: From which North African city and nation did the celebrated globetrotter Ibn Battuta originate?
qh: इब्नबतूता (Ibn Battuta) किस देश का निवासी था?
e: Ibn Battuta North Africa ke Morocco country ke Tangier city ke ek educated family me 1304 CE me paida hue the.

qe: What is the title of the Arabic travelogue authored by Ibn Battuta recounting his travels across Afro-Eurasia?
qh: इब्नबतूता के यात्रा वृत्तांत का क्या नाम है?
e: Ibn Battuta ke travelogue ka title 'Rihla' hai, jise usne Morocco lautne ke baad Ibn Juzayy ki literary assistance se compile karwaya tha.

qe: Who ruled as the Sultan of Delhi when Ibn Battuta arrived at his court in 1333 CE?
qh: इब्नबतूता जब भारत पहुँचा, उस समय दिल्ली का सुल्तान कौन था?
e: Ibn Battuta 1333 CE me overland route se Delhi pahuncha jab wahan Tughlaq sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq rule kar raha tha.

qe: To which judicial post in Delhi did Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq appoint the jurist Ibn Battuta?
qh: मोहम्मद बिन तुगलक ने इब्नबतूता को दिल्ली में किस पद पर नियुक्त किया था?
e: Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq ne Ibn Battuta ki Islamic legal expertise (sharia) se impress hokar use Delhi ka Qazi appoint kiya tha.

qe: Which two novel Indian agricultural products astounded Ibn Battuta upon his arrival in India?
qh: इब्नबतूता ने भारत के किन दो 'अनोखे' फलों/पौधों का वर्णन किया है?
e: Ibn Battuta ne human face jaise dikhne wale Coconut aur bina fruit kiye sirf leaves use hone wale Paan (betel) ko exotic plants bataya.

qe: What two operational categories of the Indian postal communication network were described by Ibn Battuta?
qh: इब्नबतूता ने भारत की किस संचार व्यवस्था (Postal System) का वर्णन किया है?
o: Uluq (Horse post) and Dawa (Foot runner post)
e: Ibn Battuta ne Mughal/Sultanate postal system me har 4 miles par horse-post (Uluq) aur har 1/3 mile par bells leke daudne wale foot-post (Dawa) ka detail diya.

qe: According to Ibn Battuta, how many days did the journey take for travelers to traverse from Sindh to Delhi?
qh: इब्नबतूता के अनुसार सिंध से दिल्ली पहुँचने में कितने दिन लगते थे?
e: Ibn Battuta ne mention kiya ki normal travelers ko Sindh se Delhi aane me 50 days lagte the, jabki news foot-runners ke network se sirf 5 din me pahunchti thi.

qe: In which century did the French physician and traveler François Bernier live in Mughal India?
qh: फ्रांसीसी यात्री फ्रेंकोइस बर्नियर (François Bernier) भारत कब आया था?
e: Francois Bernier France se aakar 1656 se 1668 CE (17th century) tak Mughal Empire me 12 saal raha.

qe: What was the professional vocation of the French visitor François Bernier?
qh: फ्रेंकोइस बर्नियर पेशे से क्या था?
e: Francois Bernier Paris university se trained Physician (doctor) tha aur intellectually political philosopher aur historian tha.

qe: In what professional capacity did François Bernier serve the eldest Mughal prince Dara Shukoh?
qh: बर्नियर ने मुगल राजकुमार दारा शिकोह के यहाँ किस रूप में सेवा की?
e: Bernier ne Shah Jahan ke eldest son aur liberal intellectual prince Dara Shukoh ke personal physician ke taur par serve kiya.

qe: What is the title of François Bernier's published European travel account on the Mughal Empire?
qh: बर्नियर की पुस्तक का नाम क्या है?
e: Bernier ne apni observations ko 'Travels in the Mughal Empire' me publish kiya, jo French king Louis XIV ko address thi aur Europe-India binary compare karti thi.

qe: What did François Bernier consider as the root structural cause of agricultural backwardness in Mughal India?
qh: बर्नियर ने भारत में कृषि की अवनति का मुख्य कारण क्या बताया?
o: Total absence of private ownership in land (Crown ownership of all land)
e: Bernier ka thesis tha ki sovereign king saari land ka absolute owner hai; private property rights na hone se peasants zameen par long-term investment nahi karte.

qe: What critical term did François Bernier apply to Mughal urban centers, claiming they depended solely on the royal court?
qh: बर्नियर ने मुगल शहरों को क्या नाम दिया?
e: Bernier ne Mughal cities ko 'Camp Towns' kaha, uska maanna tha ki ye cities tabhi exist karte hain jab imperial court aur army wahan camped hoti hai.

qe: Which Indian city did Ibn Battuta describe as an immense, heavily populated metropolis with fortified walls?
qh: इब्नबतूता ने दिल्ली के किस शहर को भारत का सबसे बड़ा शहर बताया?
e: Ibn Battuta ne Delhi ko pure Islamic East ka sabse grand, heavily fortified aur vast population wala city describe kiya.

qe: Al-Biruni compared the social hierarchy of the Indian caste system with which ancient civilization?
qh: अलबरूनी ने भारतीय समाज की किस व्यवस्था का तुलनात्मक अध्ययन किया?
e: Al-Biruni ne explain kiya ki social divisions unique nahi hain, ancient Persia me bhi knights, priests, physicians aur peasants ke 4 classes the.

qe: According to Bernier's theoretical framework, what did 'Crown ownership of land' imply?
qh: बर्नियर के अनुसार 'क्राउन ओनरशिप ऑफ लैंड' का क्या अर्थ था?
o: The Mughal Emperor was the sole proprietor of all land and peasants were mere tenants
Temples and monastic institutions controlled all acreage
Foreign joint-stock trading firms owned the provinces
e: Bernier ke mutabik king saari territory ka maalik tha jahan koi private inheritance nahi thi aur peasants destitute tenants ki tarah rehte the.

qe: Which major urban commercial center in the Deccan was noted by Ibn Battuta as rivaling Delhi in scale?
qh: इब्नबतूता ने किस भारतीय शहर को दिल्ली के समान बड़ा बताया?
e: Maharashtra me situated Daulatabad (Devagiri) ko Ibn Battuta ne size, riches aur bazaars me Delhi ke barabar formidable bataya.

qe: In what functional roles were domestic slaves commonly deployed in medieval Indian households?
qh: मध्यकालीन भारत में दासों (Slaves) को किस रूप में उपयोग किया जाता था?
o: Domestic service, palanquin bearing, musicianship, and domestic surveillance
e: Ibn Battuta ke according slaves domestic chores, palanquin lifting, female singers aur nobles ki personal surveillance ke liye widely use hote the.

qe: In his critique of Sati, where did Bernier observe a harrowing account of a coerced 12-year-old widow?
qh: बर्नियर ने सती प्रथा का वर्णन करते हुए कहाँ की 12 वर्षीय बच्ची का उल्लेख किया?
e: Bernier ne Lahore me ek innocent 12 saal ki young widow ko relatives dwara forcibly pyre me bandhkar jalaye jaane ka horrifying account likha.

qe: Which grand empire did the Persian diplomatic envoy Abdur Razzaq visit in the 1440s?
qh: अब्दुल रज्जाक समरकंदी (Abdur Razzaq) भारत के किस साम्राज्य को देखने आया था?
e: Abdur Razzaq ne 1442-43 me southern Vijayanagara Empire visit kiya jab wahan Sangama king Devaraya II rule kar rahe the.

qe: Which Delhi Sultan formulated and ruthlessly implemented the autocratic policy of 'Iron and Blood'?
qh: दिल्ली के किस सुल्तान ने 'लौह एवं रक्त' की नीति अपनाई थी?
e: Ghiyasuddin Balban ne Mewatis aur recalcitrant Rajput chiefs ko suppress karne aur sultanate ki prestige restore karne ke liye 'Iron and Blood' policy chalaayi.

qe: Between which two commanders was the decisive First Battle of Panipat fought on 21 April 1526?
qh: पानीपत का प्रथम युद्ध (1526) किसके बीच लड़ा गया था?
e: 21 April 1526 ko Babur ne gunpowder field artillery aur Tulghuma tactics use karke Delhi Sultan Ibrahim Lodi ko defeat kiya aur Mughal rule shuru kiya.

qe: Who were the dual founders who established the sovereign kingdom of Vijayanagara in 1336?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: Sangama dynasty ke do brothers Harihara aur Bukka ne Kampili ke fall ke baad Vijayanagara kingdom ki foundation rakhi thi.

qe: What is the foundational etymological meaning of the French word 'Renaissance'?
qh: पुनर्जागरण या 'रिनेसां' (Renaissance) शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
e: Renaissance ka literal meaning French me 'Rebirth' hota hai; ye 14th se 17th century ke classical Greek aur Roman intellectual revival ko darshata hai.

qe: In which geographic region did the cultural Renaissance first take root in 14th-century Europe?
qh: यूरोप में पुनर्जागरण (Renaissance) की शुरुआत सबसे पहले किस देश से हुई थी?
e: Renaissance sabse pehle Northern Italy ke prosperous merchant city-states (jaise Florence, Venice, Milan, Padua) me shuru hua.

qe: What was the core educational philosophy of 'Humanism' during the European Renaissance?
qh: पुनर्जागरण के दौरान 'मानवतावाद' (Humanism) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: Education emphasizing human agency, critical reason, grammar, history, and moral philosophy
e: Humanism (Studia humanitatis) ecclesiastical religion ke bajay insaan ke reason, liberal arts, classical literature aur potential par focus karta tha.

qe: Who authored the seminal work 'The Civilization of the Renaissance in Italy' published in 1860?
qh: 1860 में 'द सिविलाइजेशन ऑफ द रिनेसां इन इटली' नामक प्रसिद्ध पुस्तक किसने लिखी थी?
e: Swiss historian Jacob Burckhardt ne 1860 me ye book likhkar Renaissance ko modern rational worldview ka birth point establish kiya.

qe: Which Italian poet and scholar is widely venerated as the 'Father of Humanism'?
qh: किस इटालियन कवि को 'मानवतावाद का जनक' (Father of Humanism) माना जाता है?
e: Petrarch ne forgotten classical Latin manuscripts collect kiye aur individual human consciousness aur eloquence par zor diya.

qe: What did the ideal archetype of a 'Renaissance Man' (L'uomo universale) signify?
qh: पुनर्जागरण काल में 'रिनेसां मैन' (Renaissance Man) किसे कहा जाता था?
o: A specialized knight in heavy armor
A versatile polymath excelling across fine arts, sciences, languages, and athletics
An ordained cardinal in the Papal Curia
e: Renaissance man ek aisi personality ko kehte the jo multiple diverse domains (art, math, science, philosophy, sports) me equally proficient ho.

qe: Which quintessential polymath artist painted the celebrated masterpieces 'Mona Lisa' and 'The Last Supper'?
qh: प्रसिद्ध पेंटिंग 'मोनालिसा' और 'द लास्ट सपर' के रचनाकार कौन थे?
e: Florentine genius Leonardo da Vinci ne Mona Lisa aur The Last Supper create kiye the; wo painter, engineer aur anatomist the.

qe: Which sculptor-painter spent four years painting the monumental ceiling frescoes of the Sistine Chapel in Rome?
qh: माइकल एंजेलो ने किस प्रसिद्ध चर्च की छत पर 'सिस्टाइन चैपल' (Sistine Chapel) की पेंटिंग बनाई थी?
e: Michelangelo ne 1508 se 1512 ke beech Vatican ke Sistine Chapel ceiling par Genesis aur Creation of Adam ke frescoes paint kiye.

qe: Which political realism treatise did Florentine diplomat Niccolo Machiavelli author in 1513?
qh: पुनर्जागरण काल के प्रसिद्ध लेखक निकोलो मचियावेली की पुस्तक का नाम क्या है?
e: Machiavelli ne 'The Prince' (Il Principe) me state survival aur political expediency par focus kiya, morality ko statecraft se alag kiya.

qe: From which country hailed the famous Christian humanist scholar Desiderius Erasmus?
qh: प्रसिद्ध मानवतावादी विद्वान इरास्मस (Erasmus) किस देश से संबंधित थे?
e: Desiderius Erasmus Rotterdam (Holland) ke leading Christian humanist the jinhone 'Praise of Folly' likhkar clerical corruption ko satirize kiya.

qe: Which historical millennium was designated by Renaissance humanists as the intellectual 'Dark Ages'?
qh: यूरोप में 'डार्क एजेस' (Dark Ages) का काल किसे माना जाता है?
e: Humanists ne classical Roman empire ke collapse se lekar apne time (5th se 14th century) ke intermediate feudal phase ko Dark Ages term kiya.

qe: Scholars of which civilization preserved, translated, and commented on ancient Greek philosophy and science during the European Middle Ages?
qh: यूरोप में किस देश के दार्शनिकों ने प्राचीन यूनानी ग्रंथों को अरबी में अनुवाद करके सुरक्षित रखा था?
e: Baghdad aur Cordoba ke Arab scholars (Ibn Rushd, Ibn Sina) ne Aristotle, Plato aur Galen ko Arabic me translate karke Europe tak wapas transmit kiya.

qe: What did the humanist scholar Lorenzo Valla expose regarding the papal territorial charter 'Donation of Constantine'?
qh: 'डोनेशन ऑफ कांसटेनटाइन' नामक दस्तावेज को मानवतावादियों ने क्या घोषित किया?
e: Humanist Lorenzo Valla ne linguistic analysis se prove kiya ki Papacy ka claim karne wala 'Donation of Constantine' document 8th century ka forged fake paper tha.

qe: What artistic revolution distinguished Renaissance art from its flat, two-dimensional medieval predecessors?
qh: पुनर्जागरण काल की कला में 'यथार्थवाद' (Realism) से क्या तात्पर्य है?
o: Realistic anatomical accuracy, natural proportions, and linear optical perspective
e: Renaissance artists ne linear perspective, chiaroscuro (light/shade) aur human anatomy dissect karke life-like visual Realism achieve kiya.

qe: Which intellectual Renaissance noblewoman ruled the court of Mantua as a model of statesmanship and artistic patronage?
qh: प्रसिद्ध मानवतावादी महिला इसाबेला डे एस्टे (Isabella d'Este) कहाँ की शासिका थीं?
e: Isabella d'Este Mantua ki marchesa thi jinhone political leadership sambhali aur great Renaissance artists aur humanists ko patronize kiya.

qe: Which seismic geopolitical event in 1453 accelerated the flight of Greek scholars and classical manuscripts to Italy?
qh: 1453 में किस घटना के कारण कई यूनानी विद्वान भागकर इटली आ गए?
o: The Ottoman conquest of Constantinople by Sultan Mehmed II
e: 1453 me Ottoman Turks ne Constantinople conquer kiya jisse Greek scholars precious ancient texts ke sath Italy migrate ho gaye.

qe: From which linguistic root was the term 'Feudalism' derived by modern historians?
qh: फ्रांस के इतिहास में 'सामंतवाद' (Feudalism) शब्द की उत्पत्ति किस भाषा के शब्द से हुई है?
o: Germanic word 'Feud' (meaning a piece of land)
e: Feudalism German root word 'Feud' se derive hua hai jiska basic meaning land-tenure ya fief (zameen ka conditional tukda) hota hai.

qe: Medieval European society was traditionally conceptualized as divided into which 'Three Orders'?
qh: मध्यकालीन यूरोपीय समाज किन 'तीन वर्गों' (Three Orders) में विभाजित था?
o: Merchants, Guild Masters, and Day Laborers
e: Medieval clergy ne society ko functional three orders me categorize kiya tha: Those who pray (Clergy), Those who fight (Nobles), aur Those who work (Peasants).

qe: What was the fortified country estate and agricultural domain of a feudal lord termed?
qh: नोबल्स (अभिजात वर्ग) के विशाल निजी निवास और उनके खेतों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Manor feudal lord ka self-sufficient rural economic estate hota tha jisme uska fortified manor house, fields, mill, bakery aur peasant cottages hote the.

qe: Which ecclesiastical tax, amounting to one-tenth of annual agricultural harvest, was collected by the Catholic Church?
qh: चर्च द्वारा किसानों से वसूला जाने वाला वह कर कौन सा था जो उनकी उपज का दसवां हिस्सा होता था?
e: Church peasants se unki crop output ka 1/10th hissa religiously claim karta tha jise 'Tithe' kaha jata tha.

qe: What was the royal direct personal tax levied by the French crown upon commoner peasantry?
qh: राजा द्वारा किसानों पर सीधे तौर पर लगाए गए कर को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: French monarchy third estate (peasants) par direct property/poll tax impose karti thi jise 'Taille' kehte the, jisse clergy aur nobility exempt the.

qe: Who constituted the specialized armored equestrian fighting caste in the European feudal order?
qh: सामंती व्यवस्था में 'नाइट्स' (Knights) कौन थे?
o: Professional mounted heavy cavalry warriors tied to lords
e: Knights armored mounted cavalry warriors the jinhe lords unki military service ke badle fief (land) aur protection dete the.

qe: What legal category of unfree cultivators was bound to the soil of the feudal lord's manor?
qh: सामंतवाद के तहत 'सर्फ' (Serf) किन्हें कहा जाता था?
o: Serfs (Bonded agricultural tenants tied to land)
e: Serfs wo unfree peasants the jo lord ki land se legally bound the; wo bina lord ki permission ke estate chhod nahi sakte the aur unhe unpaid labour (corvee) deni padti thi.

qe: Who served as the supreme ecclesiastical head of the Western Catholic Church headquartered in Rome?
qh: कैथोलिक चर्च के सर्वोच्च मुखिया को क्या कहा जाता था, जो रोम में रहता था?
e: Rome ka Bishop poore Western Catholic Christian world ka supreme spiritual authority hota tha jise Pope (Holy Father) kaha jata hai.

qe: In which secluded, self-contained monastic retreats did Christian monks and nuns reside?
qh: यूरोप में 'भिक्षु' (Monks) कहाँ रहते थे?
e: Monks aur nuns worldly life se door isolated self-sufficient religious settlements me rehte the jinhe Monasteries ya Abbeys kehte the.

qe: Which Norman Duke invaded and conquered Anglo-Saxon England at the Battle of Hastings in 1066?
qh: 11वीं शताब्दी में किस फ्रांसीसी ड्यूक ने इंग्लैंड को जीता और वहाँ सामंतवाद लागू किया?
e: Duke William of Normandy ne 1066 me England conquer kiya aur Anglo-Saxon nobility ko replace karke French-style feudal land tenure introduce kiya.

qe: What environmental shift beginning around the 11th century stimulated agrarian productivity across Western Europe?
qh: यूरोप में 11वीं शताब्दी से कृषि के विस्तार का मुख्य पर्यावरणीय कारण क्या था?
o: Medieval Warm Period (Milder temperatures and longer growing seasons)
e: 11th century me Europe ek Warm Phase me enter hua jisse frosts kam hui, growing season lambi hui aur agriculture production rapidly expand hua.

qe: Which innovative crop rotation method replaced the wasteful two-field system in medieval European farming?
qh: खेती में सुधार के लिए 'दो खेत व्यवस्था' की जगह कौन सी नई पद्धति अपनाई गई?
e: Three-field system me land ko 3 parts me baanta gaya: autumn wheat, spring oats/legumes aur one part fallow, jisse soil nitrogen maintain rahi aur output 66% tak badha.

qe: What were the associations formed by urban master craftsmen and traders to regulate commerce called?
qh: कस्बों के व्यापारियों और कारीगरों के संघ को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Towns me har craft aur trade ka organized association hota tha jise Guild kehte the; ye quality, prices, training aur entry regulate karti thi.

qe: What grand, soaring stone churches featuring stained-glass windows were erected across France from the 12th century?
qh: 12वीं शताब्दी से फ्रांस में बने विशाल और भव्य चर्चों को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: 12th century se urban centers me bishops aur guild merchants ke donation se grand Gothic Cathedrals (jaise Notre Dame, Chartres) banaye gaye.

qe: Which devastating bubonic pandemic decimated between one-third and one-half of Europe's population in the 1340s?
qh: 14वीं शताब्दी के दौरान यूरोप में किस महामारी ने जनसंख्या का एक बड़ा हिस्सा खत्म कर दिया?
e: 1347 se 1351 ke beech 'Black Death' (plague) ne Europe ke millions logon ko kill kiya jisse acute labour shortage hui aur serfdom collapse hone laga.

qe: What was the conditional estate of land granted by a feudal lord to a knight in exchange for military service called?
qh: लॉर्ड द्वारा नाइट्स को दी गई जमीन के टुकड़े को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Lord dwara knight ko unki military obligation ke exchange me di gayi landed property ko 'Fief' (feodum) kehte the.

qe: Which emerging socio-economic class in chartered towns came to be viewed as the 'Fourth Order'?
qh: समाज का 'चौथा वर्ग' (Fourth Order) किन्हें कहा जाता था?
o: Urban burghers, townspeople, and mercantile professionals
e: Trade revolution se medieval towns me rise hone wale wealthy merchants, free citizens aur craftsmen ko 'Fourth Order' (Burghers) kaha gaya.

qe: What were the mendicant Christian monks called who chose not to live isolated in abbeys but preached among common urban people?
qh: उन भिक्षुओं को क्या कहा जाता था जो मठों में नहीं रहते थे और घूम-घूम कर उपदेश देते थे?
e: 13th century me Friars (jaise Franciscans aur Dominicans) emerge hue jo property hold nahi karte the aur sadko par ghummakkad jeevan jeete hue bhashan dete the.

qe: Which Anglo-Saxon monarch was defeated by William of Normandy at the Battle of Hastings in 1066?
qh: 1066 ईस्वी में विलियम ने इंग्लैंड के किस कबीले के राजा को हराकर सत्ता प्राप्त की थी?
e: Battle of Hastings (1066) me William the Conqueror ne Anglo-Saxon king Harold Godwinson ko defeat karke England ki gaddi capture ki.

qe: Which Benedictine abbess was celebrated across 12th-century Europe as a visionary composer and naturalist?
qh: भिक्षुओं और नन द्वारा गाए जाने वाले प्रार्थना गीतों में सुधार करने वाली एबेस (Abbass) कौन थीं?
e: German abbess Hildegard of Bingen ek gifted musical composer, medical writer aur mystic thi jinhone community chant liturgies compose kiye.

qe: Which Frankish monarch was crowned by Pope Leo III as the first 'Holy Roman Emperor' on Christmas Day in 800 CE?
qh: पवित्र रोमन सम्राट (Holy Roman Emperor) की उपाधि चर्च ने सबसे पहले किस फ्रेंच राजा को दी थी?
e: Pope Leo III ne Rome me 800 CE ko Frankish king Charlemagne ko 'Imperator Romanorum' (Holy Roman Emperor) crown kiya.

qe: What was the consultative advisory assembly of the Three Estates summoned by the kings of France called?
qh: फ्रांस की परामर्शदात्री सभा (Consultative Assembly) को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: French monarchy jab taxation aur crises par teeno orders (clergy, nobility, commoners) ke representatives ko bulati thi, use 'Estates-General' kehte the.

qe: What were the two institutional houses of the English Parliament that crystallized by the 14th century?
qh: इंग्लैंड की संसद (Parliament) के दो सदनों के नाम क्या थे?
o: House of Princes and House of Paupers
House of Lords and House of Commons
e: English Parliament 2 chambers me evolve hui: House of Lords (hereditary nobility aur bishops) aur House of Commons (knights aur town burgesses).

qe: Which metallurgical innovation protected draft horses' hooves and revolutionized land transportation in the 11th century?
qh: घोड़ों के पैरों की सुरक्षा के लिए सामंती काल में किस नई तकनीक का आविष्कार हुआ?
e: Iron horseshoe aur shoulder horse-collar ke introduction se horses ki pulling power multiple times badh gayi aur unke pair soft zameen par safe rahe.

qe: Following the death of which Mughal Emperor in 1707 did the centralized empire fragment rapidly?
qh: मुगल साम्राज्य का पतन मुख्य रूप से किस मुगल शासक की मृत्यु के बाद तेजी से शुरू हुआ?
e: 1707 me Aurangzeb ki death ke baad weak successors, jagirdari crisis aur Maratha attacks ke chalte Mughal Empire disintegrate ho gaya.

qe: Which Persian conqueror invaded Delhi in 1739, plundering the Peacock Throne and the Koh-i-Noor diamond?
qh: 1739 में ईरान के किस शासक ने दिल्ली पर आक्रमण किया और भारी लूटपाट मचाई?
e: Nadir Shah ne Battle of Karnal (1739) ke baad Delhi ko sack kiya aur Shah Jahan ka Peacock Throne aur Kohinoor loot kar le gaya.

qe: Who founded the autonomous princely state of Hyderabad in the Deccan in 1724?
qh: अठारहवीं शताब्दी में हैदराबाद राज्य की स्थापना किसने की थी?
e: Chin Qilich Khan (Nizam-ul-Mulk Asaf Jah) ne Delhi court politics se alag hokar 1724 me Hyderabad state ki sovereign foundation rakhi.

qe: Who established the autonomous hereditary governorship of Awadh in 1722?
qh: अवध के स्वतंत्र राज्य का संस्थापक किसे माना जाता है?
e: Saadat Khan Burhan-ul-Mulk ne 1722 me Awadh ka subadar appoint hokar regional dynasty establish ki aur local zamindars ko subdue kiya.

qe: Under which provincial administrator did Bengal emerge as an autonomous regional polity detached from Delhi's control?
qh: मुर्शिद कुली खान के नेतृत्व में कौन सा क्षेत्र मुगल नियंत्रण से अलग होकर एक स्वतंत्र राज्य बना?
e: Murshid Quli Khan ne provincial capital Murshidabad shift ki aur Bengal ke financial revenue system ko consolidate karke independent nawabi run ki.

qe: What did the fiscal system of 'Ijaradari' denote in 18th-century successor states?
qh: अठारहवीं शताब्दी के राज्यों में 'इजारदारी' (Ijaradari) प्रथा का संबंध किससे था?
o: Revenue farming system leased to the highest bidding contractors
e: Ijaradari revenue-farming contract system tha jahan state fixed sum ke badle tax collection rights highest bidder (ijaradar) ko lease kar deta tha.

qe: Which Sikh Guru transformed the Sikh community into the martial and political order of the Khalsa in 1699?
qh: सिखों को एक राजनीतिक और सैन्य शक्ति के रूप में संगठित करने का श्रेय किसे दिया जाता है?
e: Guru Gobind Singh Ji ne 1699 me Khalsa order create kiya jisse Sikhs Mughal oppression ke against saint-soldier community ban gaye.

qe: Who assumed military command of the Sikh forces following Guru Gobind Singh's assassination in 1708?
qh: गुरु गोबिंद सिंह की मृत्यु के बाद सिखों का नेतृत्व किसने किया और मुगलों के खिलाफ विद्रोह जारी रखा?
e: Banda Singh Bahadur ne Punjab me peasant uprising organize kiya, Guru Nanak aur Guru Gobind Singh ke coins issue kiye aur Lohgarh ko capital banaya.

qe: What was the combined military confederacy of the various Sikh Jathas and Misls termed?
qh: सिखों के विभिन्न जत्थों और मिसलों की संयुक्त सेना को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Sikh jathas ke unified army umbrella ko 'Dal Khalsa' kehte the jo Baisakhi aur Diwali par Amritsar me collective decisions (Gurmata) leti thi.

qe: Who founded the sovereign Maratha state in the 17th century by challenging Bijapur and the Mughals?
qh: मराठा साम्राज्य की नींव 17वीं शताब्दी में किसने रखी थी?
e: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj ne Western Ghats me guerrilla (ganimi kava) warfare se Deccan me sovereign Swarajya establish kiya aur 1674 me Raigad me coronation karwaya.

qe: To which executive office was the post of 'Peshwa' equivalent in the Maratha Empire?
qh: मराठा प्रशासन में 'पेशवा' (Peshwa) का पद किसके समान था?
e: Shahu Maharaj ke tenure se Balaji Vishwanath aur unke successors (Peshwas) Maratha confederacy ke de facto chief ministers aur leaders ban gaye.

qe: What was the tax amounting to 25% of land revenue demanded by the Marathas from non-Maratha territories?
qh: मराठों द्वारा पड़ोसी राज्यों से वसूले जाने वाले भू-राजस्व के 25% हिस्से को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Chauth (literal 1/4th) standard 25% land revenue demand thi jo Marathas neighbouring kingdoms se raiding avoid karne aur military protection ke badle lete the.

qe: What was the additional 9-10% revenue levy collected by Marathas as hereditary overlords of the Deccan?
qh: मराठों द्वारा मुख्य राजस्व अधिकारी होने के नाते लिया जाने वाला 9-10% अतिरिक्त कर क्या कहलाता था?
e: Sardeshmukhi 9-10% surcharge tha jo Shivaji Maharaj aur unke successors Deccan ke hereditary head headman (Sardeshmukh) hone ke ground par collect karte the.

qe: Between which two formidable powers was the Third Battle of Panipat fought on 14 January 1761?
qh: 1761 में पानीपत की तीसरी लड़ाई मराठों और किसके बीच हुई थी?
o: Ahmad Shah Abdali (Durrani) and the Marathas
The English East India Company and Marathas
e: 14 January 1761 ko Afghan king Ahmad Shah Abdali ne Sadashivrao Bhau ki command wali Maratha confederacy army ko Panipat me defeat kiya.

qe: Under which dynamic ruler did the Jat kingdom of Bharatpur attain its apex of political and military power?
qh: भरतपुर के जाट राज्य को एक शक्तिशाली राज्य के रूप में किसने संगठित किया?
e: Maharaja Suraj Mal ne Bharatpur ko strong kingdom banaya, unhe administrative brilliance aur diplomacy ke chalte 'Plato of the Jat tribe' kaha jata hai.

qe: In the Mughal court hierarchy, who were designated by the collective plural term 'Umara'?
qh: मुगल काल में 'उमरा' (Umara) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: High-ranking imperial nobility and grand mansabdars
e: Umara (Amir ka plural) Mughal administration ke top-tier elite mansabdars aur high-ranking nobles ke group ko denote karta tha.

qe: What were the hereditary ancestral estates of the Rajput princes recognized by the Mughal crown called?
qh: राजपूत शासकों को मुगल साम्राज्य के तहत दी गई उनकी जागीरें क्या कहलाती थीं?
e: Mughals Rajput rulers ko unki hereditary homeland territories me internal autonomy dete the jise 'Watan Jagir' kaha jata tha.

qe: Which premier historic city did Maharaja Ranjit Singh establish as his sovereign capital in 1799?
qh: 1799 में महाराजा रणजीत सिंह ने किस शहर को अपनी राजधानी बनाया था?
e: Maharaja Ranjit Singh ne rival Sikh misls ko unite karke 1799 me Lahore conquer kiya aur use apni sovereign Sikh kingdom ki political capital banaya.

qe: How many times did Afghan ruler Ahmad Shah Abdali invade and plunder North India between 1748 and 1761?
qh: अफ़गान शासक अहमद शाह अब्दाली ने 1748 से 1761 के बीच उत्तर भारत पर कितनी बार आक्रमण किया?
e: Ahmad Shah Abdali ne Punjab aur Delhi par 1748 se 1761 ke beech 5 major invasions kiye aur Mughal authority ko shatter kar diya.

qe: Which astronomer-king of Amber/Jaipur constructed the famous Jantar Mantar masonry observatories?
qh: जयपुर के किस शासक ने खगोलीय वेधशालाओं (जंतर-मंतर) का निर्माण करवाया था?
e: Sawai Jai Singh II ne accurate celestial calculations ke liye Delhi, Jaipur, Ujjain, Mathura aur Varanasi me 5 Jantar Mantar observatories banwayi.

qe: The 9th-century Chera kingdom of Mahodayapuram was situated in which present-day state of India?
qh: 9वीं शताब्दी में स्थापित 'महोदयपुरम का चेर राज्य' वर्तमान भारत के किस राज्य का हिस्सा था?
e: 9th century me Mahodayapuram (modern Kodungallur) me re-established Chera kingdom Kerala ke coastal belt me situated tha.

qe: Which regional vernacular language and script were officially introduced by the Cheras in their royal inscriptions?
qh: चेर शासकों ने अपने अभिलेखों में किस क्षेत्रीय भाषा और लिपि का प्रयोग सबसे पहले शुरू किया था?
e: Chera rulers ne apne official temple inscriptions me regional language Malayalam use karna start kiya, jo vernacular state use ka early example hai.

qe: In which composite literary style ('diamonds and corals') was the 14th-century grammatical text 'Lilatilakam' written?
qh: 14वीं शताब्दी का ग्रंथ 'लीलातिलकम' (Lilatilakam), जो व्याकरण और काव्यशास्त्र से संबंधित है, किस शैली में लिखा गया था?
e: Lilatilakam grammar text 'Manipravalam' (mani = ruby/coral, pravalam = pearl/diamond) style me likha gaya tha jo Sanskrit aur Malayalam ka blend tha.

qe: With which supreme Hindu divinity is the celebrated temple of Lord Jagannatha at Puri identified?
qh: ओडिशा के पुरी में स्थित 'जगन्नाथ मंदिर' का संबंध किस मुख्य देवता से है?
o: Lord Vishnu (as Lord of the World)
e: Puri ke Jagannath temple me tribal deity origin se evolve hokar Lord Jagannath ko Lord Vishnu/Krishna ka supreme form maana jata hai.

qe: Which Ganga dynasty monarch commissioned the construction of the monumental Jagannatha Temple at Puri in the 12th century?
qh: 12वीं शताब्दी में किस शासक ने पुरी में 'पुरुषोत्तम जगन्नाथ' के लिए मंदिर बनवाने का निश्चय किया था?
e: Eastern Ganga dynasty ke ruler Anantavarman Chodaganga ne 12th century me Purushottama Jagannath ke grand temple construction ka order diya tha.

qe: By what overarching territorial designation did British colonial records refer to the region of present-day Rajasthan?
qh: ब्रिटिश अधिकारी वर्तमान राजस्थान के अधिकांश भाग को किस नाम से पुकारते थे?
e: 19th century me Britishers modern Rajasthan ke Rajput-dominated princely states ke geographic belt ko 'Rajputana' kehte the.

qe: Which class of hereditary bardic minstrels preserved and recited the heroic ballads of Rajput warriors?
qh: राजपूत शासकों के दरबारों में उनकी बहादुरी की कहानियों को गीतों के रूप में कौन गाते थे?
e: Charans aur Bhats professional bard communities thi jo Rajput heroes ke valor, sacrifice aur chivalric tales ko poetic songs me compose aur preserve karte the.

qe: What heroic custom of collective self-immolation did Rajput women enact upon facing imminent military defeat?
qh: राजपूत स्त्रियों के वीरतापूर्ण कार्यों में 'जौहर' का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Jauhar (Mass voluntary self-immolation in funeral flames)
e: Defeat ke situation me enemy ke dishonor se bachne ke liye Rajput women mass level par fire pyre me jump karke 'Jauhar' karti thi.

qe: From which region and tradition of northern temple storytellers did the classical dance 'Kathak' originate?
qh: 'कथक' (Kathak) नृत्य शैली का मूल रूप से संबंध किस क्षेत्र से है?
e: Kathak word 'Katha' (story) se bana hai; ye originally North India ke temples me devotional stories recite karne wale storytellers (kathakars) ka dance tha.

qe: Under the patronage of which last Nawab of Awadh did Kathak evolve into an expressive, recognized classical court dance?
qh: अवध के किस अंतिम नवाब के संरक्षण में 'कथक' एक प्रमुख कला रूप में विकसित हुआ?
e: Awadh ke last nawab Wajid Ali Shah khud trained dancer aur poet the; unke royal court patronage me Lucknow gharana of Kathak flourish hua.

qe: What art style designates the fine, small-scale paintings executed in watercolors on palm leaf, paper, or cloth?
qh: राजस्थान और हिमाचल प्रदेश के क्षेत्रों में विकसित लघु चित्रों की शैली को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Small-scale detailed paintings jo watercolours se paper, cloth ya wood par execute ki jaati thi, unhe 'Miniatures' (laghu chitra) kehte hain.

qe: Which bold, emotionally intense early school of miniature painting blossomed in the Himalayan foothills of Basohli?
qh: हिमाचल प्रदेश की तलहटी में विकसित लघु चित्रकला की साहसी और भावप्रवण शैली को क्या नाम दिया गया है?
e: 17th century ke end me Jammu/Himachal foothills me vibrant bold colors aur high emotional intensity wali 'Basohli school' of painting emerge hui.

qe: Where did Mughal court artists seek asylum following Nadir Shah's sacking of Delhi in 1739, giving birth to the Kangra style?
qh: 18वीं शताब्दी के मध्य में नादिर शाह के आक्रमण के बाद मुगल कलाकार कहाँ शरण लेने भाग गए थे?
e: Delhi me political chaos aur Nadir Shah ke loot ke baad Mughal trained painters Himachal/Pahari hills bhaage jahan Kangra school of art originate hua.

qe: From which classical language is the formal grammar and early vocabulary of Bengali derived?
qh: बंगाली भाषा का उद्भव मूल रूप से किस भाषा से माना जाता है?
e: Bengali language Magadhi Prakrit ke through Sanskrit roots se derive hui hai, halanki ispe Persian, Arabic aur tribal languages ka heavy influence raha.

qe: In the historical context of deltaic Bengal, who was reverentially referred to as a 'Pir'?
qh: बंगाल में 'पीर' (Pir) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: A revered spiritual preceptor, saint, or pioneering community leader
e: Bengal ke forest settlements me local communities Sufi saints, spiritual guides aur forest clearance karne wale respected leaders ko 'Pir' kehti thi.

qe: What architectural roof form featuring two sloped curved thatch-style gables developed in medieval Bengal?
qh: बंगाल के मंदिरों की छतों की विशिष्ट शैली, जिसमें दो ढलान वाली छतें होती थीं, क्या कहलाती थी?
e: Bengal me curved bamboo thatch roofs ko replicate karke temples banaye jaate the: 2-roofs wale structure ko 'Do-chala' aur 4-roofs wale ko 'Chau-chala' kehte the.

qe: Which 13th-century Sanskrit ritual manual from Bengal officially relaxed dietary taboos to permit local Brahmins to consume fish?
qh: 13वीं शताब्दी के किस संस्कृत ग्रंथ ने बंगाल के ब्राह्मणों को मछली खाने की अनुमति दी थी?
e: Brihaddharma Purana ne Bengal me fish ki high dietary ubiquity ko recognize karte hue local Brahmins ko specific white-scaled fish khane ki religious sanction di.

qe: For what exquisite decorative exterior finish are the historic temples of Bishnupur in Bankura (Bengal) renowned?
qh: बंगाल के बांकुरा जिले में स्थित 'बिष्णुपुर' के मंदिर अपनी किस सजावट के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं?
o: Ornate carved terracotta brick tiles and bas-relief murals
e: Malla kings ke Bishnupur temples me brick walls par Ramayana aur Krishna-leela ke scenes carved Terracotta tiles se decorate kiye gaye hain.

qe: What aesthetic qualities defined the lyrical Kangra school of Pahari painting?
qh: कांगड़ा चित्रकला शैली (Kangra school of painting) की मुख्य विशेषता क्या थी?
o: Soft lyrical execution using cool blues and greens with poetic treatment of Krishna themes
e: Kangra painting cool blues aur greens ke delicate use, lyrical poetry aur Radha-Krishna ke bhakti themes ke graceful representation ke liye famous hai.

qe: Who emerged as the foremost saint-leader of the ecstatic Gaudiya Vaishnava Bhakti movement in Bengal?
qh: बंगाल में वैष्णव भक्ति आंदोलन के सबसे प्रमुख नेता कौन थे?
e: 16th century me Chaitanya Mahaprabhu ne Bengal me Gaudiya Vaishnavism lead kiya aur group singing (Sankirtana) ke through Krishna bhakti spread ki.

qe: Who propounded the influential philosophical system of radical non-dualism known as 'Advaita' in 8th-century India?
qh: भक्ति आंदोलन के संदर्भ में 'अद्वैतवाद' (Advaita) का सिद्धांत किसने प्रतिपादित किया था?
e: Kerala me born Adi Shankaracharya ne Advaita philosophy di jiske according Atman aur Param-Brahman identical hain aur material world Maya hai.

qe: According to the philosophy of Shankaracharya, what is the fundamental nature of ultimate 'Brahman'?
qh: शंकराचार्य के अनुसार 'ब्रह्म' का स्वरूप कैसा है?
o: Nirguna, formless, attribute-less, and the sole immutable cosmic reality
e: Shankaracharya ne sikhaya ki Brahman 'Nirguna' aur 'Nirakara' (without physical attributes/form) hai aur knowledge (Jnana) se hi uski realization possible hai.

qe: Which theological doctrine of qualified non-dualism was expounded by the 11th-century Tamil saint Ramanuja?
qh: 11वीं शताब्दी में तमिलनाडु में जन्मे 'रामानुज' (Ramanuja) किस विचारधारा के समर्थक थे?
e: Ramanuja ne 'Vishishtadvaita' diya jiske according soul (Atman) Supreme God (Brahman) se unite hone ke baad bhi apni conscious individuality preserve karti hai.

qe: Which Tamil devotional saint-poets deeply inspired the theological formulations of Ramanuja?
qh: रामानुज किन संतों से बहुत अधिक प्रभावित थे?
e: Ramanuja Vishnu-bhakta Alvars ke hymns se deeply influenced the aur unhone devotional surrender (Prapatti) ko salvation ka highest path maana.

qe: The South Indian 'Nayanar' saints were the devotional worshippers of which Hindu divinity?
qh: नयनार (Nayanars) संत किस हिंदू देवता के उपासक थे?
e: Nayanars Lord Shiva ke ardent devotees the, jabki Alvars Lord Vishnu ke worshippers the.

qe: What are the traditional canonical counts of the Nayanar and Alvar saints respectively?
qh: नयनार और अलवार संतों की कुल संख्या क्रमशः कितनी मानी जाती है?
e: Tamil tradition me 63 Shaivite Nayanars (Tevaram me collected) aur 12 Vaishnavite Alvars record kiye gaye hain.

qe: Who initiated the Virashaiva socio-religious movement through revolutionary Kannada Vachana poetry?
qh: कर्नाटक में 'वीरशैव आंदोलन' (Virashaiva movement) की शुरुआत किसने की थी?
e: Basavanna, Allama Prabhu aur Akka Mahadevi ne 12th century Kalachuri court me Virashaiva movement chalaya jo Shiva par focused tha.

qe: Against which entrenched socio-religious orthodoxies did the Virashaiva movement vehemently protest?
qh: वीरशैवों ने किस सामाजिक बुराई के विरुद्ध प्रबल तर्क दिए थे?
o: Brahmanical caste hierarchies, temple ritualism, and institutional gender discrimination
e: Virashaivas ne caste inequality, idol worship, temple monopoly aur women ke subjugation ko Vachanas ke through fiercely reject kiya.

qe: Which pilgrimage temple at Pandharpur served as the supreme epicentre for the Varkari Bhakti saints of Maharashtra?
qh: महाराष्ट्र के पंढरपुर में भक्ति का केंद्र कौन सा मंदिर था?
e: Pandharpur ka Vitthala (Vithoba - Vishnu ka localized avatar) temple Maharashtra ke Varkari saints (Dnyaneshwar, Tukaram) ki Bhakti ka main center tha.

qe: To which social caste, traditionally classified as 'untouchable', did the Marathi saint-poet Chokhamela belong?
qh: महाराष्ट्र के प्रसिद्ध संत 'चोखामेला' (Chokhamela) किस वर्ग से संबंधित थे?
e: Sant Chokhamela Mahar community se belong karte the; unke abhangas social discrimination aur pure inner devotion ka deep record hain.

qe: What spiritual path to ultimate liberation was championed by the Nathpanthis, Siddhas, and Yogis?
qh: नाथपंथियों, सिद्धों और योगियों ने मोक्ष पाने के लिए किस पर बल दिया?
o: Intensive mind-body discipline through yogic postures, breath control, and meditation on the formless reality
e: Nathpanthis aur Yogis ne world renunciation, asanas (postures), pranayama (breathing) aur meditation se Sahaja realization par stress diya.

qe: In Sufi institutional nomenclature, what is meant by a 'Silsila'?
qh: सूफी संतों के संदर्भ में 'सिलसिला' (Silsila) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
o: A continuous spiritual genealogy and lineage connecting masters back to Prophet Muhammad
e: Silsila Sufi orders ki spiritual genealogy (unbroken chain) hoti hai jisme har master apne successor ko spiritual lineage pass karta hai.

qe: Which became the most culturally pervasive and widely embraced Sufi order across the Indian subcontinent?
qh: भारत में सबसे प्रभावशाली सूफी सिलसिला कौन सा था?
e: Chishti silsila India me sabse popular aur integrated bana kyunki unhone musical gatherings (Sama), local idioms aur open hospitality adopt ki.

qe: What was the specialized communal lodging and assembly complex of a Sufi master called?
qh: सूफी संत जहाँ अपनी सभाएँ आयोजित करते थे, उन स्थानों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Khanqah Sufi master ka monastic community centre hota tha jahan murids spiritual training lete the aur communal langar chalta tha.

qe: In which occupational household community was the saint-poet Kabir Das raised in Varanasi?
qh: संत कबीर का पालन-पोषण किस परिवार में हुआ था?
e: Kabir ka palan-poshan Varanasi me ek newly-converted Muslim weaver (Julaha) family me hua tha, jo unki textile metaphors me jhalakta hai.

qe: Which textual repositories preserve the revolutionary verses and sakhis composed by Sant Kabir?
qh: कबीर की रचनाओं और उपदेशों को किन ग्रंथों में सुरक्षित किया गया है?
o: Both Bijak/Panchvani and the Guru Granth Sahib
e: Kabir ke verses Bijak (Kabirpanthi tradition), Panchvani (Dadu panth, Rajasthan) aur Adi Granth (Sikh tradition) teeno me preserved hain.

qe: What linguistic medium was employed by Sant Kabir to ensure his verses resonated with common masses?
qh: कबीर की कविता की भाषा कैसी थी जिससे वे आम लोगों के बीच लोकप्रिय हुए?
e: Kabir ne dialectical spoken Hindi (Sadhukkadi) use ki jo aam logon ki bhasha thi, sath hi unhone shocking paradoxical Ulatbansi poetry likhi.

qe: Where was Guru Nanak Dev Ji born in 1469 in the Punjab province?
qh: गुरु नानक देव का जन्म 1469 में कहाँ हुआ था?
e: Guru Nanak ka birth 1469 me village Talwandi Rai Bhoe (ab Nankana Sahib, Pakistan) me hua tha.

qe: What was the universal community kitchen instituted by Guru Nanak at Kartarpur called?
qh: गुरु नानक ने करतारपुर में अपने अनुयायियों के लिए जो साझा रसोई शुरू की थी, उसे क्या कहते हैं?
e: Kartarpur me Guru Nanak ne Langar establish kiya jahan sabhi followers ek sath baithkar khana khate the, jo caste distinctions ko reject karta tha.

qe: Whom did Guru Nanak Dev choose as his devoted successor, conferring upon him the name Guru Angad?
qh: गुरु नानक देव ने अपना उत्तराधिकारी किसे चुना था?
e: Guru Nanak ne apne dedicated disciple Bhai Lehna ko choose kiya aur unhe 'Angad' (mere shareer ka hissa) naam dekar successor banaya.

qe: Which fifth Sikh Guru compiled the holy Adi Granth at Amritsar in 1604?
qh: सिखों के पवित्र ग्रंथ 'गुरु ग्रंथ साहिब' का संकलन 1604 में किसने पूरा किया था?
e: 5th Guru Arjan Dev Ji ne 1604 me Adi Granth compile kiya jisme Sikh Gurus ke sath-sath Kabir, Namdev, Ravidas aur Baba Farid ki bani shamil ki.

qe: What military fraternity of the Sikh faith was forged by Guru Gobind Singh at Anandpur Sahib in 1699?
qh: गुरु गोबिंद सिंह ने 1699 में सिखों के किस सैन्य और राजनीतिक संगठन की स्थापना की थी?
e: 1699 me Guru Gobind Singh Ji ne Khalsa Panth banaya jisme baptized Sikhs ko 'Panch Kakar' (5 Ks) aur martial identity assign ki gayi.

qe: Which three cardinal ethical pillars summarize the practical teachings of Guru Nanak?
qh: गुरु नानक की शिक्षाओं का सार किन तीन शब्दों में निहित है?
o: Nam, Dan, Isnan (Right worship, welfare of others, and purity of conduct)
e: Guru Nanak ki philosophy 'Nam Japna' (divine remembrance), 'Kirat Karni' (honest earning) aur 'Vand Chhakkna' (sharing/Dan) par based thi.

qe: In which vernacular dialect of Hindi did Goswami Tulsidas compose the celebrated epic 'Ramcharitmanas'?
qh: तुलसीदास ने रामचरितमानस की रचना किस भाषा में की थी?
e: Tulsidas ne Ramayana ko Sanskrit se aam logon tak pahunchane ke liye Eastern Uttar Pradesh ki vernacular bhasha 'Awadhi' me Ramcharitmanas likha.

qe: Whom did the celebrated Mewari princess-saint Mirabai accept as her spiritual master?
qh: राजपूत राजकुमारी मीराबाई ने किसे अपना आध्यात्मिक गुरु बनाया था?
e: Mirabai ne untouchable tanner caste se aane wale mystic poet Sant Ravidas (Raidas) ko apna guru accept karke caste orthodoxy ko defy kiya.

qe: Which 15th-century Gujarati saint-poet authored the famous hymn 'Vaishnava Jana To Tene Kahiye'?
qh: किस प्रसिद्ध गुजराती संत ने कहा था - 'वैष्णव जन तो तेने कहिये जे पीर पराई जाणे रे'?
e: Gujarat ke Vaishnava saint Narsinh Mehta ne ye hymn likha tha jo empathy aur compassion ko sacha religious character batata hai.

qe: Which 15th-century reformer-saint pioneered the Neo-Vaishnavite Bhakti resurgence in the Brahmaputra Valley of Assam?
qh: असम में भक्ति मार्ग को लोकप्रिय बनाने वाले प्रमुख संत कौन थे?
e: Srimanta Sankaradeva ne Assam me Ekasarana Dharma preach kiya aur devotional community centres ke roop me 'Sattras' aur 'Namghars' establish kiye.

qe: In Sufi ritual assembly, what does the mystical practice of 'Sama' refer to?
qh: सूफी शब्दावली में 'समा' (Sama) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Spiritual music, singing, and audition designed to induce divine ecstasy
e: Sama Sufi devotional gathering thi jahan spiritual poetry aur Qawwali ke zariye mystic ecstasy (hal/wajd) experience kiya jata tha.

qe: Which Sikh Guru was executed in 1606 under the imperial orders of Mughal Emperor Jahangir?
qh: मुगल सम्राट जहाँगीर ने 1606 में किस सिख गुरु को मृत्युदंड देने का आदेश दिया था?
e: Rebel prince Khusrau ko blessings dene aur Sikh community ke growing political influence ke suspicion me Jahangir ne Guru Arjan Dev Ji ko execute karwaya.

qe: Who spearheaded the Protestant Reformation in Germany in 1517 by challenging the Catholic Church's sale of indulgences?
qh: 16वीं शताब्दी में जर्मनी में 'धर्म सुधार आंदोलन' (Reformation) का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: Martin Luther ne 1517 me Wittenberg church door par 95 Theses nail karke Catholic Church ke indulgences aur papal authority ko challenge kiya.

qe: Which normative prescriptions were predominantly disregarded by independent tribal societies in medieval India?
qh: मध्यकाल में जनजातीय समाज ब्राह्मणों द्वारा बनाए गए किन नियमों का पालन नहीं करता था?
o: Brahmanical caste hierarchies and elaborate ritualistic taboos
e: Tribal societies egalitarian clans par based thi aur wo varna-based caste rules aur Brahmanical rituals ko follow nahi karti thi.

qe: Which primary historical repository is utilized by anthropologists and historians to construct tribal histories?
qh: जनजातीय समूहों के बारे में जानकारी प्राप्त करने के लिए इतिहासकार मुख्य रूप से किस स्रोत का उपयोग करते हैं?
o: Richly preserved oral traditions and folklore
e: Tribal societies me written manuscripts nahi the; unki history unke oral folk songs, folklore aur community memory se reconstruct ki jaati hai.

qe: Which tribal confederacy in Bihar and Jharkhand was subdued by Akbar's general Raja Man Singh in 1591?
qh: अकबर के प्रसिद्ध सेनापति राजा मानसिंह ने 1591 में किस जनजातीय समूह को पराजित किया था?
e: Raja Man Singh ne 1591 me Chero chieftains par attack karke unhe loot liya aur defeat kiya, halanki wo poori tarah subdue Aurangzeb ke time hue.

qe: Which tribal chieftain of the Gakkhar community was elevated to the status of an imperial Mansabdar by Emperor Akbar?
qh: मुगल सम्राट अकबर के शासनकाल में 'कमाल खान गक्खड़' को किस पद पर नियुक्त किया गया था?
e: Punjab ke Potwar region ke Gakkhar chief Kamal Khan Gakkhar ki loyalty aur military leadership dekhkar Akbar ne use Mansabdar banaya.

qe: Why were pastoral nomadic communities continually mobile across vast geographical tracts?
qh: खानाबदोश पशुपालक अपने जानवरों के साथ एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान क्यों घूमते थे?
o: Cyclical search for seasonal grazing pastures and water resources for herds
e: Pastoral nomads apne sheep, goats aur cattle ke seasonal grazing needs aur water availability ke according alag-alag ecological zones me move karte the.

qe: Who constituted the paramount pastoral-trader nomads transporting grain for armies across medieval India?
qh: मध्यकालीन भारत में सबसे महत्वपूर्ण व्यापारी खानाबदोश (Trader Nomads) कौन थे?
