e: Banjaras premier nomadic grain merchants the jo oxen par thousands of quintals grain load karke military campaigns aur urban markets me supply karte the.

qe: What was the extensive caravan or collective convoy of the Banjaras termed?
qh: बंजारों के कारवां या काफिले को किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
e: Banjaras ke caravan ko 'Tanda' kehte the; ek Tanda me thousands of bullocks aur hundreds of families ek sath move karti thi.

qe: According to the Akbarnama, how many villages were administratively unified within the Gond kingdom of Garha Katanga?
qh: अकबरनामा के अनुसार, गोंड राज्य 'गढ़ कटंगा' में कुल कितने गाँव शामिल थे?
e: Abul Fazl ne Akbarnama me mention kiya hai ki Gond state of Garha Katanga (Mandla/Jabalpur) me 70,000 populated villages the.

qe: In the administrative structure of the Gond kingdom, what was a 'Chaurasi'?
qh: गोंड प्रशासनिक व्यवस्था में 'चौरासी' (Chaurasi) क्या था?
e: Gond kingdom Garhs me divided tha; har Garh 84 villages ki unit 'Chaurasi' me batta tha, jo aage 12 villages ke 'Barhots' me sub-divided hota tha.

qe: Which prestigious Rajput title did Aman Das, the Gond Raja of Garha Katanga, adopt to elevate his status?
qh: गढ़ कटंगा के गोंड राजा अमन दास ने कौन सी उच्च उपाधि धारण की थी?
e: Aman Das ne Rajput Kshatriya status assert karne ke liye 'Sangram Shah' ka title adopt kiya aur apne bete Dalpat ki marriage Chandel princess Durgavati se karwayi.

qe: Against which Mughal commander did the heroic Gond warrior-queen Rani Durgavati fight to her death in 1565?
qh: रानी दुर्गावती ने 1565 में किस मुगल सेनापति के विरुद्ध लड़ते हुए वीरगति प्राप्त की थी?
e: 1565 me Mughal general Asaf Khan ne Garha Katanga par attack kiya; Rani Durgavati ne bravery se fight kiya aur surrender karne ke bajay suicide choose kiya.

qe: From which modern Southeast Asian country did the Tai-Ahom group migrate into the Brahmaputra Valley in the 13th century?
qh: अहोम (Ahom) जनजाति 13वीं शताब्दी में वर्तमान के किस देश से आकर ब्रह्मपुत्र घाटी में बसी थी?
e: Tai-Ahom group 1228 CE me Sukaphaa ke leadership me upper Myanmar ke Mong Mao se Patkai hills cross karke Assam me settle hua.

qe: In Ahom society, who were the conscripted labourers bound to render mandatory state service?
qh: अहोम समाज में वे लोग कौन थे जिन्हें राज्य के लिए जबरन काम करना पड़ता था?
e: Ahom administration Paik system par based tha jahan common villagers compulsory rotational public works aur military service provide karte the.

qe: On what administrative mechanism was the state service of the Ahom Paiks systematically extracted?
qh: अहोम शासन के दौरान जनगणना के आधार पर पाइक (Paiks) को किस आधार पर सेवा देनी पड़ती थी?
o: On a rotational roster basis determined by a systematic village census
e: State census maintain karta tha aur heavily populated villages se logon ko dusri jagah shift karke rotational basis par Paiks se kaam karwata tha.

qe: In the clan-based social hierarchy of the Ahoms, what was a 'Khel'?
qh: अहोम प्रशासन की सबसे छोटी इकाई 'कुल' या 'खेल' (Khel) का नियंत्रण मुख्य रूप से किस पर था?
o: An organized kinship-based guild or administrative clan controlling groups of villages
e: Ahom society me 'Khel' clan-based guilds hoti thi jo unke command me aane wale multiple villages aur Paiks ke groups ko administratively govern karti thi.

qe: Which Mughal viceroy of Bengal invaded the Ahom kingdom and captured their capital Garhgaon in 1662?
qh: 17वीं शताब्दी के उत्तरार्ध में अहोमों के विरुद्ध मुगल आक्रमण का नेतृत्व किसने किया था?
e: 1662 me Aurangzeb ke general Mir Jumla ne Ahom capital Garhgaon capture ki, halanki continuous guerrilla resistance se Mughals permanent control nahi rakh paaye.

qe: What were the official court chronicles written in the Ahom language and subsequently in Assamese called?
qh: अहोम राज्य के ऐतिहासिक वृत्तांतों को क्या कहा जाता है, जिन्हें पहले अहोम और फिर असमिया भाषा में लिखा गया?
e: Ahom state me detailed historical chronicles maintain kiye jaate the jinhe 'Buranji' kaha jata tha; pehle ye Ahom language me aur baad me Assamese me likhe gaye.

qe: Which prominent pastoral shepherd community inhabited the Western Himalayas?
qh: पश्चिमी हिमालय में रहने वाली मुख्य जनजातीय गड़रिया जाति कौन सी थी?
e: Himachal Pradesh aur Jammu ke Western Himalayan valleys me 'Gaddi' pastoral shepherd tribe rehti thi jo seasonal migration karti thi.

qe: Which ancestral agrarian technique was traditionally practiced by the Gond tribes in central India?
qh: गोंड लोग खेती के लिए किस प्राचीन पद्धति का उपयोग करते थे?
e: Gonds traditionally forest patches ko cut aur burn karke shifting cultivation (jise locally Bewar ya Dahiya kehte the) practice karte the.

qe: Which indigenous kingdom of Northeast India manufactured gunpowder and used cannons as early as the 1530s?
qh: किस जनजातीय समूह ने 1530 के दशक में ही आग्नेयास्त्रों (Firearms) और बारूद का प्रभावी उपयोग शुरू कर दिया था?
e: Ahoms ne 1530s me hi firearms utilize karna shuru kar diya tha aur 17th century tak unke paas high-quality saltpetre gunpowder aur cannons banane ki expertise thi.

qe: During the imperial Chola reign, what multifunctional urban role did the royal capital of Thanjavur exemplify?
qh: चोल काल के दौरान 'तंजावुर' नगर किस प्रकार के केंद्र का एक उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण था?
o: A grand imperial administrative capital and vibrant temple town
e: Thanjavur Chola empire ki political capital thi jahan imperial bureaucracy, markets, Rajarajeshvara temple aur cultural activities ek sath hub banaye hue the.

qe: Which sovereign Chola monarch commissioned the construction of the monumental Rajarajeshvara Temple at Thanjavur?
qh: तंजावुर में स्थित प्रसिद्ध 'राजराजेश्वर मंदिर' का निर्माण किस चोल शासक ने करवाया था?
e: Rajaraja I ne 1010 CE me Thanjavur me Brihadisvara (Rajarajeshvara) temple banwaya jo Dravidian stone architecture ka pinnacle hai.

qe: What socio-economic urbanization process characterized settlements developing around medieval pilgrimage shrines?
qh: मध्यकाल में मंदिरों के आसपास बस्तियाँ बसने और नगरों के विकसित होने की प्रक्रिया को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Medieval period me temples land grants, banking, crafts aur fairs ke economic hubs ban gaye, jisse unke chaaro taraf 'Temple Towns' ka urbanization hua.

qe: What was the international commercial function of South Indian merchant guilds like 'Manigramam' and 'Nanadesi'?
qh: दक्षिण भारत के प्रसिद्ध व्यापारिक संघों (Guilds) में 'मणिग्रामम्' और 'नानादेशी' का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
o: Conducting extensive long-distance maritime and overland trade across Southeast Asia and China
e: Manigramam aur Nanadesi powerful South Indian trade guilds thi jo internal India aur overseas Southeast Asia aur China ke sath maritime commerce chalati thi.

qe: Which Deccan artisanal town gave its name to the fine metallic inlay craft of silver and copper on zinc alloys?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'बिदरी' (Bidri) शिल्प का नाम किस स्थान के नाम पर पड़ा जहाँ के शिल्पकार तांबे और चाँदी में जड़ाई के काम के लिए प्रसिद्ध थे?
e: Bahmani/Barid Shahi capital Bidar ke artisans zinc-copper alloy par fine silver aur brass inlay work karte the jise 'Bidriware' kaha gaya.

qe: In the river basin of which two Deccan waterways was the fortified city of Hampi strategically established?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य की राजधानी 'हम्पी' किन नदियों के बेसिन में स्थित थी?
e: Hampi dry Krishna-Tungabhadra doab basin me granite hills ke natural defense ring ke beech establish ki gayi thi.

qe: What remarkable mortarless stonemasonry technique was implemented to erect the defensive walls of Hampi?
qh: हम्पी की किलेबंदी की दीवारों के निर्माण में किस विशिष्ट तकनीक का प्रयोग किया गया था?
o: Interlocking wedge technique without the use of any mortar or cementing agent
e: Hampi ki outer fortification walls me kisi mortar ya cement ka use nahi hua; massive granite blocks ko trapezoidal interlocking pattern me wedge kiya gaya tha.

qe: Why was the bustling Gujarati port of Surat designated the 'Gate to Mecca' during the Mughal era?
qh: गुजरात का 'सूरत' शहर मुगल काल में किस नाम से प्रसिद्ध था क्योंकि यहाँ से मक्का के लिए यात्री जहाज रवाना होते थे?
e: Surat Mughal Empire ka premier port tha jahan se Hajj pilgrims ke ships Red Sea ke liye sail karte the, isliye use 'Bab-ul-Makkah' kehte the.

qe: For what exquisite gold-lace border craftsmanship were the cotton textiles of Surat internationally celebrated?
qh: सूरत के सूती वस्त्र अपने किस काम के लिए प्रसिद्ध थे, जिनका बाजार पश्चिम एशिया, अफ्रीका और यूरोप में फैला था?
e: Surat cotton aur silk textiles apne genuine gold aur silver thread borders ('Zari') ke liye famous the jo West Asia aur Europe export hote the.

qe: What commercial and financial instrument was designated by the term 'Hundi' in medieval Indian banking?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'हुंडी' (Hundi) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: A bill of exchange recording a financial deposit redeemable at a distant location
e: Hundi ek financial bill of exchange hota tha jisme merchant credit deposit record hota tha; ise bina cash carry kiye kisi doosri city me merchant redeem kar sakta tha.

qe: What was the primary geopolitical identity of Masulipatnam (Machilipatnam) on the Andhra coast in the 17th century?
qh: आंध्र तट पर स्थित 'मसूलीपट्टनम' (मछलीपट्टनम) 17वीं शताब्दी में किस चीज का प्रमुख केंद्र था?
o: A flourishing international port contested by Dutch and English East India Companies
e: Golkonda kingdom ke control me Masulipatnam Andhra coast ka main trade port tha jahan Dutch aur Britishers ne textile export ke liye factories banayi.

qe: Who resided in the segregated residential quarters termed 'Black Towns' in 18th-century colonial presidency cities?
qh: 18वीं शताब्दी में यूरोपीय कंपनियों द्वारा बसाए गए 'ब्लैक टाउन' (Black Towns) में कौन लोग रहते थे?
o: Native Indian merchants, artisans, and weavers
e: Colonial Madras aur Calcutta me Britishers Fort area (White Town) me rehte the, jabki native Indian weavers, traders aur artisans ko 'Black Towns' me segregate kiya gaya.

qe: In overland Asian commerce during the Mughal period, for which trade were Kabul and Qandahar famously known?
qh: मुगल काल के दौरान 'काबुल' और 'कंधार' व्यापारिक रूप से किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध थे?
o: High-value horse trade and dry fruits
e: Kabul aur Qandahar overland Silk Route transit points the jahan se Central Asia se thousands of fine cavalry horses aur dry fruits India aate the.

qe: Which sophisticated metallurgical method was utilized to cast hollow and solid Chola bronze sculptures?
qh: चोलकालीन कांस्य मूर्तियाँ बनाने के लिए किस विशिष्ट तकनीक का प्रयोग किया जाता था?
e: Chola bronzes (jaise Nataraja) Lost-Wax process (Cire Perdue) se banaye jaate the jisme beeswax model par clay coat karke molten metal pour kiya jata tha.

qe: In which major overseas banking centers were the credit Hundis issued by Surat merchant bankers reliably honored?
qh: सूरत का बैंकिंग नेटवर्क इतना मजबूत था कि उसकी 'हुंडियों' को किन विदेशी बाजारों में मान्यता प्राप्त थी?
e: Surat ke Mahajans ka financial credibility itna solid tha ki unki Hundis Cairo, Basra aur Europe ke Antwerp bazaar me directly cash exchange hoti thi.

qe: At which monumental platform did the Vijayanagara king conduct state rituals and receive vassal tributes during the Mahanavami festival?
qh: विजयनगर साम्राज्य में 'महानवमी' उत्सव के दौरान राजा अपनी शक्ति और प्रतिष्ठा का प्रदर्शन कहाँ करता था?
e: Mahanavami festival ke 9 dino me king Mahanavami Dibba par baithkar state rituals, wrestling, animal sacrifices aur tributary nayakas ki army reviews leta tha.

qe: What socio-economic role was performed by the 'Banjaras' in medieval Indian logistics?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'बंजारे' (Banjaras) मुख्य रूप से क्या थे?
o: Nomadic merchant-caravan transporters of essential grain and provisions
e: Banjaras nomadic merchant communities thi jo transport bullocks ke zariye large scale par foodgrains gaon se cities aur military camps me supply karti thi.

qe: What direct commercial factor triggered the decline of the port city of Masulipatnam in the late 17th and 18th centuries?
qh: मसूलीपट्टनम का पतन 18वीं शताब्दी में क्यों शुरू हुआ?
o: The shift of European commercial centers to the fortified colonial ports of Bombay, Calcutta, and Madras
e: Mughals dwara Golkonda capture hone aur British/French companies ke Bombay, Madras aur Calcutta shift hone se Masulipatnam ka trade collapse ho gaya.

qe: What was the definitive historical catalyst for the destruction and abandonment of the imperial city of Hampi?
qh: हम्पी के विनाश का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: The military sacking by the allied Deccan Sultanates following the Battle of Talikota in 1565
e: 1565 me Battle of Talikota ke baad allied Deccan Sultanates ki victorious armies ne Hampi city me enter karke use thoroughly pillage aur ruin kar diya.

qe: The holy Pushkar Lake situated near Ajmer is celebrated for housing the rare temple of which Hindu divinity?
qh: अजमेर के पास स्थित 'पुष्कर' झील किस देवता के एकमात्र मंदिर के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Ajmer ke paas Pushkar Lake ancient pilgrimage site hai jahan world ka sabse prominent temple of Lord Brahma situated hai.

qe: Who initiated the construction of the base storey of the monumental Qutub Minar in Delhi around 1199 CE?
qh: कुतुब मीनार की पहली मंज़िल का निर्माण लगभग 1199 में किसने करवाया था?
e: Qutbuddin Aibak ne 1199 me Qutub Minar ki first storey banwayi thi, jiske baad remaining 3 storeys Iltutmish ne complete karwayi.

qe: What characterizes the classical 'Trabeate' (corbelled) structural technique in early medieval temple and palace architecture?
qh: 8वीं से 13वीं शताब्दी के बीच मंदिरों और इमारतों में छत, दरवाजे और खिड़कियाँ बनाने की 'ट्रैबिएट' (Trabeate) तकनीक क्या थी?
o: Constructing a true radiating keystone arch
Placing a horizontal cross-beam across two upright vertical pillars
e: Trabeate (anuparastha toda) technique me do vertical pillars par ek horizontal stone beam rakhkar roofs, doors aur windows banaye jaate the.

qe: Which Chandela dynasty king commissioned the construction of the magnificent Kandariya Mahadeva Temple at Khajuraho in 999 CE?
qh: खजुराहो में स्थित 'कंदरिया महादेव मंदिर' का निर्माण 999 ईस्वी में किस वंश के राजा धंगदेव द्वारा किया गया था?
e: Chandela ruler Dhangadeva ne 999 CE me Khajuraho complex me Lord Shiva ko dedicated grand Kandariya Mahadeva Temple construct karwaya.

qe: Who built the grand Rajarajeshvara Temple at Thanjavur, which possessed the tallest temple Shikhara of its era?
qh: तंजौर के 'राजराजेश्वर मंदिर' का शिखर अपने समय के मंदिरों में सबसे ऊँचा था। इसका निर्माण किसने करवाया था?
e: Chola emperor Rajaraja I ne Thanjavur me ye temple banwaya jiska shikhara 66 meters uncha tha aur iske top par 90-ton stone dome install kiya gaya tha.

qe: What engineering solution was implemented by Chola architects to roll a 90-ton granite stone to the apex of the Rajarajeshvara Temple?
qh: राजराजेश्वर मंदिर के 90 टन भारी पत्थर को शिखर तक पहुँचाने के लिए वास्तुकारों ने कौन सा रास्ता बनाया था?
o: A graded, four-kilometer-long earthen incline ramp path
e: Cranes na hone ke karan architects ne 4 km door village (Charupallam) se sloping earthen incline path banaya jisse 90-ton stone ko top tak roll kiya gaya.

qe: In the 'Arcuate' architectural style that emerged in the 12th century, what was the structural function of the 'Keystone'?
qh: 12वीं शताब्दी में वास्तुकला की 'मेहराबदार' (Arcuate) शैली में 'की-स्टोन' (Key-stone) का क्या महत्व था?
o: Locking the central arch to transfer superstructure weight to vertical abutments
e: Arcuate style me arch ke center me wedge-shaped 'Keystone' (daat) lagta tha jo superstructure ke downward load ko arch pillars par transfer karta tha.

qe: Where was the grand public water reservoir 'Hauz-i-Sultani' (King's Reservoir) constructed by Sultan Iltutmish?
qh: दिल्ली के सुल्तान इल्तुतमिश ने 'हौज़-ए-सुल्तानी' का निर्माण कहाँ करवाया था, जिसके लिए उन्हें बहुत सम्मान मिला?
o: Just outside the settlement walls of Dehli-i-Kuhna
e: Iltutmish ne common public ke water access ke liye Dehli-i-Kuhna city ke outside broad reservoir 'Hauz-i-Sultani' banwaya tha.

qe: Beyond displaying wealth and military might, why did medieval kings patronize monumental temples and mosques?
qh: मध्यकाल में मंदिर और मस्जिदें शासकों द्वारा अपनी शक्ति और धन के प्रदर्शन के अलावा और किसलिए बनाई जाती थीं?
o: Exclusively for storage of foreign merchandise
To proclaim divine legitimacy and demonstrate intimacy with the supreme divine power
e: Medieval rulers religious structures build karke claim karte the ki wo God ke chosen representatives ya shadow of God (Zill-i-Ilahi) hain taaki moral legitimacy mile.

qe: Which 9th-century Pandya monarch invaded Sri Lanka and carried off a priceless golden statue of Buddha from the jewel palace?
qh: 9वीं शताब्दी के दौरान किस पाण्ड्य राजा ने श्रीलंका पर आक्रमण कर बुद्ध की स्वर्ण प्रतिमा छीन ली थी?
e: Pandya king Shrimara Shrivallabha ne Sri Lanka invade kiya aur King Sena I ke palace se pure gold Buddha statue loot kar Tamil country le aaya.

qe: With statues pillaged from which vanquished rulers did Chola king Rajendra I adorn his imperial Shiva temple?
qh: चोल राजा राजेंद्र प्रथम ने अपने द्वारा निर्मित शिव मंदिर को किन शासकों से लूटी गई मूर्तियों से भर दिया था?
o: Chalukyas, Kalingas, and Palas of Bengal
e: Rajendra I ne Gangaikondacholapuram temple me defeated Chalukyas (Surya pitha), Kalingas (Bhairava/Nandi) aur Bengal ke Palas (Kali) se captured murtis install ki.

qe: Which formal geometric garden layout did Mughal Emperor Babur popularize and describe in his autobiography?
qh: मुगल सम्राट बाबर ने अपनी आत्मकथा में किस प्रकार के उद्यानों में अपनी रुचि का वर्णन किया है?
e: Babur ne apni memoirs Baburnama me 'Chahar Bagh' garden layout me deep interest express kiya jisme walled garden ko intersecting canals se 4 equal parts me baanta jata tha.

qe: What characterizes the decorative inlay architectural technique known as 'Pietra Dura'?
qh: मुगल वास्तुकला में 'पितरा-दूरा' (Pietra Dura) तकनीक का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Inlaying precious and semi-precious coloured stones into carved depressions in marble or sandstone
e: Pietra Dura (Parchin Kari) me white marble par lapis lazuli, onyx aur jasper jaise semi-precious stones ko carve karke floral patterns embed kiye jaate the.

qe: Which Greek mythological figure is depicted in Pietra Dura behind Shah Jahan's throne in the Diwan-i-Am of the Red Fort?
qh: शाहजहाँ ने दिल्ली के लाल किले में अपने सिंहासन के पीछे किस ग्रीक देवता को वीणा बजाते हुए 'पितरा-दूरा' में चित्रित करवाया था?
e: Red Fort ke Diwan-i-Am me throne ke peeche Greek god Orpheus ki pietra dura picture hai jiska lute music violent beasts ko tame kar deta tha, representing royal justice.

qe: In the 'River-Front Garden' layout pioneered by Shah Jahan in the Taj Mahal, where was the primary tomb situated?
qh: मुगल शासकों द्वारा अपनाई गई 'रिवर-फ्रंट गार्डन' (River-Front Garden) शैली में मुख्य इमारत या निवास कहाँ स्थित होता था?
o: Directly in the geometric center of the Chahar Bagh
At the edge of the garden on a high terrace adjacent to the river bank
e: Traditional Chahar Bagh ke center me tomb rakhne ke bajay Taj Mahal me white marble tomb ko Yamuna riverfront edge ke terrace par place kiya gaya.

qe: In his new imperial capital Shahjahanabad, to whom did Shah Jahan grant exclusive residential access to the Yamuna riverfront?
qh: शाहजहाँ ने अपनी नई राजधानी 'शाहजहाँनाबाद' में यमुना नदी के तट पर केवल किसे अपना घर बनाने की अनुमति दी थी?
o: Favoured royal princes like Dara Shukoh and top imperial nobles
e: Shahjahanabad me riverfront mansions sirf royal family aur Dara Shukoh jaise highest favoured aristocrats ko allotted the; baaki city walled interior me develop hui.

qe: What architectural vaulting design developed in Bengal was integrated by Mughal emperors into their palatial architecture?
qh: बंगाल के स्थानीय शासकों द्वारा विकसित 'बाँध की झोपड़ी' वाली छत की शैली को मुगलों ने किस नाम से अपनाया?
o: Bangla Dome (Curved roof mimicking bamboo thatch)
e: Bengal ki traditional curved hut roof ko Mughals ne adopt kiya jise 'Bangla Dome' (chhajja) kehte hain, jo Agra Fort aur Red Fort me prominent hai.

qe: The architecture of Jodh Bai's palace inside Fatehpur Sikri exhibits pronounced stylistic influences from which regional kingdom?
qh: फ़तेहपुर सीकरी के 'जोधाबाई महल' की वास्तुकला पर किस क्षेत्र की वास्तुकला शैली का गहरा प्रभाव दिखता है?
e: Fatehpur Sikri ke Jodh Bai palace ke brackets, pillars aur carved motifs par Gujarat aur Malwa ke Hindu-Jain temple architecture ka direct impact dikhta hai.

qe: Which architectural style characterized by soaring heights, pointed arches, and stained-glass windows emerged in 12th-century France?
qh: 12वीं शताब्दी के दौरान फ्रांस में बने ऊँचे और हल्के चर्चों की शैली को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: 12th century France me Gothic architecture originate hua jisme pointed arches, ribbed vaults, flying buttresses aur stained-glass windows use hoti thi.

qe: In early medieval South India, what did the administrative term 'Nagaram' designate?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'नगरम्' (Nagaram) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: Guilds and administrative organizations of merchants in market towns
e: Chola administration me 'Nagaram' commercial market towns me traders aur merchants ki governing corporate body hoti thi jo civic affairs manage karti thi.

qe: What ceremonial function did the 'Diwan-i-Aam' and 'Diwan-i-Khas' serve in Mughal imperial palaces?
qh: मुगल काल में 'दीवान-ए-आम' और 'दीवान-ए-खास' का मुख्य प्रयोजन क्या था?
o: Halls of audience for public petitions and confidential imperial council
e: Diwan-i-Aam public audience ke liye tha jahan emperor aam janta se petitions leta tha, aur Diwan-i-Khas private cabinet meetings aur foreign envoys ke liye tha.

qe: Who founded the Mughal Empire in India following his military victory at Panipat in 1526?
qh: मुगल साम्राज्य की स्थापना 1526 में किसने की थी?
e: Fergana ke prince Babur ne 1526 me First Battle of Panipat jeet kar Delhi aur Agra me Mughal dynasty establish ki.

qe: From whom were the Mughal monarchs matrilineally descended on their mother's side?
qh: मुगल शासक अपनी माता की ओर से किसके वंशज थे?
e: Mughals mother's side se Mongol warlord Genghis Khan (Chingiz Khan) ke descendants the, halanki wo khud ko 'Timurids' kehlana pasand karte the.

qe: Patrilineally on their father's side, which Central Asian empire-builder did the Mughals trace descent from?
qh: मुगल अपने पिता की ओर से किसके उत्तराधिकारी या वंशज माने जाते थे?
e: Father's side se Babur Central Asia, Iran aur Iraq ke conqueror Timur (Tamerlane) ka 5th generation direct descendant tha.

qe: Whom did Babur decisively vanquish in the Battle of Khanwa in 1527 to secure his hold over Northern India?
qh: बाबर ने 1527 में खानवा के युद्ध में किसे पराजित किया था?
e: 1527 me Battle of Khanwa me Babur ne Mewar ke Rana Sanga aur unke Rajput confederacy alliance ko defeat kiya.

qe: Which Mughal Emperor lost his throne to Sher Shah Suri, went into exile in Safavid Persia, and recaptured Delhi in 1555?
qh: किस मुगल सम्राट को दो बार शासन करना पड़ा और बीच में उसे ईरान भागना पड़ा था?
e: Humayun Battle of Chausa (1539) aur Kannauj (1540) me Sher Shah se har kar Persia bhag gaya tha; 1555 me usne Safavid help se wapas Delhi recapture ki.

qe: At what tender age did Jalaluddin Muhammad Akbar ascend the Mughal throne following Humayun's death in 1556?
qh: अकबर मात्र कितने वर्ष की आयु में सम्राट बना था?
e: Humayun ki sudden death ke baad 1556 me Kalanaur (Punjab) me Akbar ko sirf 13 years ki age me coronation karwaya gaya.

qe: Who served as the guardian regent (Ataliq) of young Emperor Akbar during the initial years of his reign (1556-1560)?
qh: अकबर के शासनकाल के शुरुआती वर्षों में उसका संरक्षक (Regent) कौन था?
e: Bairam Khan Akbar ka regent aur military commander tha jinhone Second Battle of Panipat (1556) me Hemu ko defeat kiya tha.

qe: In the administrative bureaucracy of the Mughal Empire, what did a 'Mansab' designate?
qh: मुगल प्रशासन में 'मनसब' (Mansab) शब्द का क्या अर्थ था?
o: A standardized institutional rank or position
e: Mansab ka matlab imperial hierarchy me rank ya position hota tha, jo official ka pay (zat) aur military troop requirement (sawar) fix karta tha.

qe: Which innovative land revenue assessment system based on 10-year crop surveys was instituted by Raja Todar Mal?
qh: अकबर के राजस्व मंत्री टोडरमल ने कौन सी नई राजस्व प्रणाली शुरू की थी?
e: Akbar ke finance minister Raja Todar Mal ne 1580 me 'Ain-i-Dahsala' (Zabt) system introduce kiya jo past 10 years ke crop yields aur average prices par based tha.

qe: Who authored the official court chronicle 'Akbarnama' documenting the life and reign of Emperor Akbar?
qh: अकबर की जीवनी 'अकबर नामा' के लेखक कौन थे?
e: Akbar ke close friend aur navratna Abul Fazl ne Persian language me official three-volume biography 'Akbarnama' compose ki.

qe: Which volume of the Akbarnama comprises the statistical, legal, and administrative compendium known as 'Ain-i-Akbari'?
qh: 'आईने-अकबरी' (Ain-i-Akbari) अकबर नामा का कौन सा खंड (Volume) है?
e: Akbarnama ka third volume 'Ain-i-Akbari' hai jisme Mughal administrative machinery, rules aur economic survey data codified hai.

qe: What were the major administrative provinces of the Mughal Empire called?
qh: मुगल साम्राज्य में प्रांतों (Provinces) को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Mughal Empire provinces me divided tha jinhe 'Subas' kehte the, aur har Suba ka head political-military officer 'Subadar' hota tha.

qe: What was the foundational philosophical principle behind Emperor Akbar's policy of 'Sulh-i-kul'?
qh: अकबर द्वारा शुरू किए गए 'सुलह-ए-कुल' (Sulh-i-kul) के विचार का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Universal peace, ethical tolerance, and justice across all religions
e: Sulh-i-kul ka literal meaning 'Universal Peace' tha; ye state policy thi jisme religion ke basis par discrimination nahi hota tha aur justice par focus tha.

qe: In provincial Mughal administration, which executive was charged with financial management and revenue audits?
qh: मुगल प्रशासन में 'दीवान' (Diwan) किस विभाग का प्रमुख अधिकारी होता था?
e: Suba level par 'Diwan' financial aur revenue officer hota tha jo center ke directly report karta tha aur Subadar ki powers ko counterbalance karta tha.

qe: Where was Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan confined by his son Aurangzeb during his final years?
qh: शाहजहाँ को उसके अंतिम दिनों में कहाँ कैद कर दिया गया था?
e: War of succession ke baad Aurangzeb ne Shah Jahan ko Agra Fort ke Musamman Burj me confine kar diya jahan se wo Taj Mahal dekh sakte the.

qe: What imperial honorific title was conferred upon Mehrunnisa following her marriage to Emperor Jahangir?
qh: जहांगीर की पत्नी 'मेहरून्निसा' को किस उपाधि से सम्मानित किया गया था?
e: 1611 me Mehrunnisa se nikah ke baad Jahangir ne use 'Nur Mahal' aur baad me 'Nur Jahan' (Light of the World) ka title diya; unke naam par coins bhi issue hue.

qe: What was the primary civil responsibility of the 'Kotwal' in Mughal urban governance?
qh: मुगल काल में 'कोतवाल' (Kotwal) का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
o: Town police commander maintaining law, order, and night watch
e: Kotwal city ka chief police officer hota tha jo law and order, night patrolling, market pricing aur census records maintain karta tha.

qe: Which theological dialogue chamber did Akbar construct at Fatehpur Sikri in 1575 for interfaith debates?
qh: अकबर ने विभिन्न धर्मों के विद्वानों के साथ चर्चा करने के लिए किस स्थान का निर्माण करवाया था?
e: Akbar ne 1575 me Fatehpur Sikri me 'Ibadat Khana' construct kiya jahan pehle Muslim sects aur baad me Hindu, Christian, Jain aur Zoroastrian scholars debate karte the.

qe: Which Maratha sovereign was humiliated in the Mughal court at Agra by Aurangzeb in 1666, prompting his escape?
qh: औरंगजेब ने किस क्षेत्र के राजा 'शिवाजी' का अपमान किया था, जिसके बाद उन्होंने मुगलों के खिलाफ संघर्ष किया?
e: Treaty of Purandar ke baad 1666 me Shivaji Maharaj Agra court gaye jahan Aurangzeb ne unhe low rank mansabdars ke peeche khada karke insult kiya, jahan se wo escape hue.

qe: What was the institutional role of the imperial official designated as 'Mir Bakshi' in the Mughal Empire?
qh: मुगल काल में 'बख्शी' (Bakshi) नामक अधिकारी का क्या उत्तरदायित्व था?
o: Military paymaster in charge of mansabdars' records and military inspection
e: Mir Bakshi head of military department tha jo mansabdars ke appointment, military muster verification aur salary payment certificates issue karta tha.

qe: Under which medieval Rajput dynasty did Delhi first rise to prominence as a kingdom's capital in the 12th century?
qh: दिल्ली पहली बार किस राजवंश के शासनकाल में साम्राज्य की राजधानी बनी?
e: 12th century ke middle me Tomar Rajputs (Anangpal Tomar) ke rule ke under Delhi (Dhillika) pehli baar capital bani.

qe: Which regional power defeated the Tomars in the mid-12th century to capture sovereign control over Delhi?
qh: तोमर राजपूतों को 12वीं शताब्दी के मध्य में किसने पराजित कर दिल्ली पर अधिकार किया था?
e: Ajmer ke Chahamanas (Chauhans) ne 12th century me Tomars ko defeat karke Delhi ko apne kingdom me merge kiya.

qe: What was the official administrative and court language throughout the tenure of the Delhi Sultanate?
qh: दिल्ली सल्तनत के सुल्तानों के शासनकाल में प्रशासन की भाषा कौन सी थी?
e: Delhi Sultanate ke administrative offices, chronicles aur court proceedings me Persian (Farsi) official language thi.

qe: What did the historiographical term 'Tawarikh' (singular: Tarikh) denote during the Sultanate era?
qh: इतिहास में 'तवारीख' (Tawarikh) शब्द का प्रयोग किसके लिए किया जाता था?
o: Chronicles and written historical narratives composed by learned court secretaries
e: Tawarikh (Tarikh ka plural) un historical chronicles ko kaha jata tha jo literate secretaries, poets aur courtiers Persian me compose karte the.

qe: Whose daughter was Raziyya Sultan, who ascended the throne of the Delhi Sultanate in 1236 CE?
qh: सन् 1236 में दिल्ली की सुल्तान बनने वाली रजिया सुल्तान किसकी पुत्री थी?
e: Raziyya Sultan Iltutmish ki daughter thi; Iltutmish ne apne incompetent sons ke bajay Raziyya ko apna heir nominate kiya tha.

qe: What ideological judgment did chronicler Minhaj-i-Siraj render regarding the reign of Raziyya Sultan?
qh: इतिहासकार मिन्हाज-ए-सिराज ने रजिया सुल्तान के बारे में क्या विचार व्यक्त किए थे?
o: She was entirely incompetent to rule
She was far more capable than her brothers, but her rule violated the divinely ordained gender hierarchy
She was a brilliant general who conquered the Deccan
She had no understanding of statecraft
e: Minhaj-i-Siraj ne maana ki wo apne sabhi bhaiyo se zyada capable aur qualified thi, par medieval patriarchal mindset ke chalte female rule unhe unacceptable laga.

qe: What was the military definition of a 'Garrison Town' in the early Delhi Sultanate?
qh: दिल्ली सल्तनत में 'गैरिसन टाउन' (Garrison Town) का क्या अर्थ था?
o: A heavily fortified urban settlement housing a stationed standing military garrison
A hospice for foreign caravan travelers
e: Garrison town (jaise Siri ya Hansi) ek walled fortified settlement hota tha jahan soldiers troops ke sath stationed hote the taaki border secure rahe.

qe: What did the spatial term 'Hinterland' denote in the context of medieval Sultanate garrison towns?
qh: दिल्ली सल्तनत के आरंभिक काल में 'हिंटरलैंड' (Hinterland) शब्द किसके लिए प्रयुक्त होता था?
o: The adjacent countryside and agricultural land that supplied goods, grain, and provisions to a city
The inner residential sanctum of a royal fort
e: Hinterland city ke surrounding us rural agricultural area ko kehte the jo city ya port ko food, supplies aur trade raw materials provide karta tha.

qe: Whom did Sultan Iltutmish elevate into trust-bound provincial military governors in preference to hereditary aristocrats?
qh: इल्तुतमिश ने विश्वसनीय गवर्नर और प्रशासक बनाने के लिए किन लोगों को प्राथमिकता दी थी?
e: Iltutmish ne aristocrats par trust na karke Persian elite-trained military slaves 'Bandagan' ko governors banaya kyunki unki loyalty sirf Sultan ke prati thi.

qe: What was the territorial revenue assignment granted to military commanders in the Delhi Sultanate called?
qh: दिल्ली सल्तनत में सैन्य कमांडरों को दी जाने वाली ज़मीन को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Military commanders ko di gayi territorial revenue assignments ko 'Iqta' kehte the aur unke holders ko 'Iqtadar' ya 'Muqti' kaha jata tha.

qe: What was the primary constitutional duty expected of an Iqtadar or 'Muqti' in his assigned province?
qh: इक्तादार या 'मुक्ति' (Muqti) का मुख्य कर्तव्य क्या था?
o: Leading military campaigns and maintaining provincial law and order with assigned troops
e: Muqti ka main obligation military campaigns me troops provide karna, revenue collect karna aur apne assigned territory me law and order maintain karna tha.

qe: What proportion of peasant harvest was extracted as 'Kharaj' under the agrarian regulations of Alauddin Khalji?
qh: अलाउद्दीन खिलजी के शासनकाल में कृषि पर लगाए जाने वाले कर 'खराज' की दर क्या थी?
e: Alauddin Khalji ne standard land tax 'Kharaj' ko enhance karke standard 50% of total agricultural produce fix kiya tha.

qe: Which Mongol conqueror founded the steppe empire whose successors launched repeated raids on Delhi under Khalji and Tughluq?
qh: अलाउद्दीन खिलजी और मोहम्मद तुगलक के समय में भारत पर आक्रमण करने वाले मंगोल नेता कौन थे?
e: Genghis Khan ke under unite hue Mongols ne 1219 me Transoxiana invasion ke baad Sultanate frontiers par continuous pressure banaya tha.

qe: Which new fortified garrison town was constructed by Alauddin Khalji in Delhi to station his standing army against the Mongols?
qh: मंगोल आक्रमणों से सुरक्षा के लिए अलाउद्दीन खिलजी ने दिल्ली में कौन सा नया गैरिसन टाउन (शहर) बसाया था?
e: Alauddin Khalji ne Mongol threat se deal karne ke liye Delhi me 'Siri' namak new circular garrison city construct kiya tha.

qe: Which Sultan of Delhi ordered the forced migration of Delhi's urban population to his southern capital of Daulatabad?
qh: किस सुल्तान ने दिल्ली के निवासियों को जबरन दक्षिण भारत की नई राजधानी 'दौलताबाद' स्थानांतरित किया था?
e: Muhammad bin Tughluq ne South India par control rakhne ke liye 1327 me capital Delhi se Daulatabad (Devagiri) shift karwayi jisse logo ko immense misery hui.

qe: Why did the brass and copper 'Token Currency' introduced by Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq collapse in disaster?
qh: मुहम्मद तुगलक द्वारा शुरू की गई 'टोकन करेंसी' (सांकेतिक मुद्रा) असफल क्यों रही?
o: The coins were excessively heavy to transport
The coins were struck in rare metals
The state failed to control minting, leading to massive domestic counterfeiting of copper/brass tokens
e: Token coins me state monopoly na hone se har house mint ban gaya aur log easily counterfeit coins forge karke taxes pay karne lage.

qe: What interdependent societal relationship was conceptualized by medieval Islamic chroniclers as the 'Circle of Justice'?
qh: इतिहासकार 'सर्कल ऑफ जस्टिस' (न्याय चक्र) का संबंध किससे मानते हैं?
o: The mutual dependence binding the King, the standing army, state revenue, and prosperous peasantry
e: Circle of Justice state karta hai: King army par depend karta hai, army salary par, salary taxes par, aur taxes tabhi aayenge jab peasants prosperous aur protected honge.

qe: Which Afghan ruler defeated Humayun in the battles of Chausa and Kannauj to seize the throne of Delhi in 1540?
qh: 15वीं शताब्दी में शेरशाह सूरी ने किस मुगल सम्राट को हराकर दिल्ली पर अधिकार किया था?
e: Sher Shah Suri ne Humayun ko 1539 (Chausa) aur 1540 (Kannauj/Bilgram) me defeat karke Sur Empire establish kiya.

qe: Which institutional administrative structure instituted by Sher Shah Suri served as the direct operational model for Akbar?
qh: शेरशाह सूरी के प्रशासन का वह कौन सा मॉडल था जिसे बाद में सम्राट अकबर ने अपनाया था?
o: His systematic land measurement, revenue assessment, road network, and administrative divisions
e: Sher Shah ki systematic revenue system (ray), pargana administration aur Grand Trunk road networks ko Akbar ne adopt aur refine kiya.

qe: What rural defensive strategy used by Indian forest chieftains to resist Sultanate forces was described by Ibn Battuta?
qh: प्रसिद्ध मोरक्कन यात्री इब्न बतूता ने दिल्ली सल्तनत के बारे में किस पक्ष का विस्तृत वर्णन किया है?
o: Fortifying themselves inside dense, impassable bamboo groves impervious to fire
e: Ibn Battuta ne describe kiya ki local chieftains impenetrable bamboo forests me hide ho jaate the jahan sword aur fire ka asar nahi hota tha aur wahi se resist karte the.

qe: What political title was conferred upon wealthy landowners and warrior chieftains by early medieval monarchs in the 7th century?
qh: सातवीं शताब्दी के दौरान बड़े भूस्वामियों या योद्धा सरदारों को राजाओं द्वारा किस रूप में मान्यता दी गई थी?
e: Kings influential landlords ko 'Samantas' ke roop me acknowledge karte the jo court me gifts laate the aur wars me military help dete the.

qe: Which Rashtrakuta chieftain overthrew his Badami Chalukya overlord and performed the royal 'Hiranya-Garbha' ritual?
qh: राष्ट्रकूट वंश के किस शासक ने अपने चालुक्य स्वामी की अधीनता से इनकार कर दिया और 'हिरण्य-गर्भ' नामक अनुष्ठान किया?
e: Dantidurga ne 8th century me Chalukyas ko overthrow karke Rashtrakuta kingdom banayi aur Ujjain me 'Hiranya-Garbha' mahadana perform kiya.

qe: What was the ritualistic theological objective of conducting the 'Hiranya-Garbha' ceremony?
qh: 'हिरण्य-गर्भ' (Hiranya-Garbha) अनुष्ठान का शाब्दिक अर्थ क्या है?
o: Golden Womb ritual symbolizing the rebirth of a non-Kshatriya sacrificer as a legitimate Kshatriya
e: Hiranya-Garbha (Golden Womb) ritual Brahmins dwara perform karwaya jata tha taaki non-Kshatriya ruler symbolically Kshatriya rebirth claim kar sake.

qe: Which two learned Brahmin lineages abandoned their priestly professions to carve out independent warrior kingdoms in Karnataka and Rajasthan?
qh: कदम्ब मयूरशर्मन और गुर्जर-प्रतिहार हरिश्चंद्र ने अपना पारंपरिक पेशा छोड़कर क्या अपनाया?
o: Taking up arms and establishing kingdoms (Kadamba Mayurasharman & Gurjara-Pratihara Harichandra)
e: Kadamba Mayurasharman (Karnataka) aur Gurjara-Pratihara Harichandra (Rajasthan) Brahmins the, jinhone traditional duties chhodkar military kingdoms establish kiye.

qe: What sovereign political claim was asserted by early medieval monarchs when adopting the title 'Maharajadhiraja'?
qh: मध्यकाल में राजाओं द्वारा धारण की गई उच्च ध्वनि वाली उपाधि 'महाराजाधिराज' का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Great King, Overlord of subordinate kings
e: Maharajadhiraja ka matlab 'King of Kings' hota tha, jisse ruler apne subordinate samantas aur chote kings par superior suzerainty assert karta tha.

qe: Among the 400 taxes recorded in Chola epigraphs, how was the ubiquitously cited 'Vetti' tax exacted?
qh: चोल शिलालेखों में वर्णित 400 से अधिक करों (taxes) में सबसे अधिक उल्लेखित 'वेट्टि' (Vetti) कर किस रूप में लिया जाता था?
o: In the form of uncompensated forced labour
e: Chola inscriptions me 'Vetti' sabse frequently mentioned tax tha jo cash me nahi balki free forced labour ke roop me liya jata tha.

qe: Which Gurjara-Pratihara king's martial conquests across Northern India are commemorated in the Sanskrit Gwalior Prashasti?
qh: ग्वालियर (मध्य प्रदेश) से प्राप्त प्रशस्ति में किस गुर्जर-प्रतिहार शासक की उपलब्धियों का वर्णन मिलता है?
e: Gwalior Prashasti Gurjara-Pratihara ruler Nagabhata I ki military victories aur Arab invasions ko resist karne ke achievements record karti hai.

qe: Who authored the historical chronicle 'Rajatarangini' (River of Kings) documenting the dynastic history of Kashmir?
qh: कश्मीर के राजाओं का इतिहास बताने वाली प्रसिद्ध संस्कृत कविता 'राजतरंगिणी' के लेखक कौन थे?
e: 12th century me Kashmiri scholar Kalhana ne 'Rajatarangini' likhi, jise critical historical method (inscriptions, coins, records) ka pioneer text maana jata hai.

qe: Which three rival dynasties engaged in the centuries-long 'Tripartite Struggle' for control over the city of Kanauj?
qh: गंगा घाटी में स्थित 'कन्नौज' शहर पर नियंत्रण के लिए किन तीन पक्षों के बीच 'त्रिपक्षीय संघर्ष' (Tripartite Struggle) हुआ?
e: Ganga valley ke fertile Kanauj trade center par supremacy ke liye Gurjara-Pratiharas (West), Palas (East) aur Rashtrakutas (Deccan) centuries tak aapas me ladte rahe.

qe: Which wealthy Gujarat temple along the Arabian Sea was repeatedly plundered by Sultan Mahmud of Ghazni?
qh: अफगानिस्तान के सुल्तान महमूद गजनी ने भारत के किस प्रसिद्ध मंदिर पर 17 बार आक्रमण कर उसकी संपत्ति लूटी?
e: Mahmud of Ghazni ne 1025-26 CE me coastal Gujarat ke rich Somnath temple ko raid karke immense gold aur wealth plunder ki.

qe: Which court scholar was commissioned by Mahmud of Ghazni to author an account of India, resulting in the 'Kitab-al-Hind'?
qh: महमूद गजनी ने किस विद्वान को उपमहाद्वीप का लेखा-जोखा लिखने का काम सौंपा था, जिसने 'किताब-उल-हिंद' लिखी?
e: Al-Biruni ne Sanskrit seekhkar Indian texts ka study kiya aur Ghazni ke command par comprehensive Arabic text 'Kitab-al-Hind' likha.

qe: Which Afghan Sultan defeated the Chahamana ruler Prithviraj III at the historic Second Battle of Tarain in 1192?
qh: तराइन के युद्ध (1191 और 1192) में पृथ्वीराज तृतीय का मुकाबला किस अफगान शासक से हुआ था?
e: 1191 me First Battle of Tarain me Prithviraj Chauhan jeete, lekin 1192 me Second Battle me Muhammad Ghori ne unhe defeat kiya jisse Sultanate rule ki neenv padi.

qe: Which ancient Chola chieftain captured the Kaveri Delta from the Muttaraiyar and founded Thanjavur in the 9th century?
qh: उरैयूर के प्राचीन चोल परिवार के 'विजयालय' ने 9वीं सदी के मध्य में मुत्तरैयार को हराकर किस शहर पर कब्जा किया?
e: Vijayalaya ne 850 CE me Muttaraiyar chiefs ko defeat karke Thanjavur capture kiya aur Imperial Chola dynasty ki foundation rakhi.

qe: Who ascended the throne in 985 CE as the greatest imperial consolidator and reformer of the Chola Empire?
qh: चोल वंश का सबसे शक्तिशाली शासक किसे माना जाता है, जो 985 ईस्वी में राजा बना?
e: Rajaraja I (985-1014 CE) ne Chola navy organize ki, administrative land surveys conduct karwaye aur Thanjavur ka grand temple banwaya.

qe: Which military branch was extensively expanded by Rajendra I to launch overseas naval expeditions to Srivijaya and the Ganges?
qh: चोल शासक राजेंद्र प्रथम ने गंगा घाटी, श्रीलंका और दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया के देशों पर विजय के बाद कौन सी नौसेना विकसित की थी?
e: Rajendra I ne powerful Chola Navy use karke Bay of Bengal cross kiya, Srivijaya (Sumatra/Malay) ko raid kiya aur 'Gangaikonda Chola' title liya.

qe: In Chola society, beyond functioning as sanctums of worship, what broader role did temples play?
qh: चोल काल के मंदिर केवल पूजा के स्थान नहीं थे, बल्कि वे किस चीज के केंद्र भी थे?
o: Nuclei of civic, economic, craft production, and cultural life
e: Chola temples large landholders, major employers, banks aur bronze casting jaise craft industries ke central economic hubs the.

qe: In the administrative hierarchy of the Chola Empire, what were individual peasant settlements termed?
qh: चोल प्रशासन में किसानों की बस्तियों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Common non-brahmanical peasants (Vellalar) ki agricultural village settlements ko 'Ur' kaha jata tha.

qe: What was an administrative cluster or grouping of multiple villages called in the Chola governance system?
qh: चोल काल में गाँवों के समूह को क्या कहा जाता था, जो न्याय करने और कर वसूलने जैसे कार्य करते थे?
e: Multiple 'Ur' villages milkar larger administrative unit 'Nadu' banate the jo justice aur revenue collection functions manage karti thi.

qe: Under the Chola land classification system, what was 'Shalabhoga' land?
qh: चोल अभिलेखों के अनुसार 'शालाभोग' (Shalabhoga) किस प्रकार की भूमि को कहा जाता था?
o: Land gifted directly to temple deities
Land granted for the maintenance and upkeep of a school
Tax-free land allotted to learned Brahmins
e: Chola inscriptions me school ke maintenance aur running ke liye reserved land ko 'Shalabhoga' kaha gaya hai.

qe: According to the Uttaramerur inscriptions, how were members of the governing committees of the village Sabha elected?
qh: उत्तरमेरुर (तमिलनाडु) के शिलालेख के अनुसार सभा (Sabha) की समितियों के सदस्यों का चुनाव किस पद्धति से किया जाता था?
o: Direct royal appointment by the monarch
Lottery/Ticket selection (Kuduvalai system using palm leaves drawn from an earthen pot)
e: Uttaramerur inscription batata hai ki eligible candidates ke naam palm leaf tickets par likhkar pot me daale jaate the aur chota bacha draw karta tha (Kuduvalai system).

qe: What unusual geographical orientation was depicted in the 1154 CE world map drawn by Arab cartographer Al-Idrisi?
qh: 1154 ईस्वी में अरब भूगोलवेत्ता अल-इदरीसी ने जो मानचित्र बनाया था, उसमें आधुनिक मानचित्र की तुलना में क्या प्रमुख अंतर था?
o: South India was placed at the top and Sri Lanka was oriented towards the north
The map was rendered as a flat disc
e: Al-Idrisi ke map me South direction upar top par thi aur North niche, isliye South India upar aur Sri Lanka island top par dikhaya gaya tha.

qe: In the 13th century, for which geographical territory did chronicler Minhaj-i-Siraj apply the term 'Hindustan'?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'हिंदुस्तान' शब्द का प्रयोग 13वीं शताब्दी में मिन्हाज-ए-सिराज ने किन क्षेत्रों के लिए किया था?
o: The Punjab, Haryana, and the agricultural lands between the Ganga and Yamuna
e: Minhaj-i-Siraj ne 'Hindustan' political sense me un lands ke liye use kiya jo Delhi Sultan ke territorial domain me aati thi (Punjab, Haryana, Ganga-Yamuna doab).

qe: In what comprehensive ecological and cultural context did Babur employ the term 'Hindustan' in his 16th-century memoirs?
qh: 16वीं शताब्दी में बाबर ने 'हिंदुस्तान' शब्द का प्रयोग किस संदर्भ में किया था?
o: To describe an Islamic political nation
To describe the geography, fauna, flora, and customs of the subcontinent's inhabitants
Exclusively for the walled city of Delhi
e: Babur ne 'Hindustan' term subcontinent ke overall geography, natural vegetation, animals aur local people ke lifestyle ko describe karne ke liye use kiya.

qe: What did the term 'Foreigner' (Pardesi / Ajnabi) convey in medieval village society?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'विदेशी' (Foreigner) शब्द का क्या अर्थ था?
o: Someone hailing from outside the borders of India
Any stranger who appeared in a village and was not part of that local society or culture
e: Medieval period me 'Foreigner' (pardesi) ka matlab desh ke bahar ka vyakti nahi tha; ek gaon ke liye padosi gaon ka koi bhi unknown stranger pardesi hota tha.

qe: Which primary historical source expanded massively for historians studying the medieval period due to cheaper paper?
qh: इतिहासकारों के लिए मध्यकाल की जानकारी का सबसे प्रमुख और बढ़ता हुआ स्रोत कौन सा बन गया था?
o: Textual records and manuscripts written on paper
e: Paper ka manufacturing cheap aur widely available hone ke chalte chronicles, holy texts, letters aur accounts jaise Textual Records exponentially badh gaye.

qe: Before the invention of mechanical printing, what were the professional copyists who handwrote manuscripts called?
qh: पाण्डुलिपियों (Manuscripts) की नकल करने वाले 'नकलनीस' या 'लिपिक' को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Printing press na hone ki wajah se learned copyists haath se manuscripts copy karte the jinhe 'Scribes' ya 'Katib' kaha jata tha.

qe: What was the cumulative textual consequence of scribes introducing small scribal errors while hand-copying manuscripts over centuries?
qh: हाथ से नकल करते समय लिपिकों (Scribes) द्वारा किए गए छोटे-छोटे बदलावों का क्या परिणाम हुआ?
o: Texts remained identical to the original
Different handwritten copies of the same text developed substantial variations over time
e: Continuous hand copying me words aur sentences alter hote gaye, jisse centuries baad same book ke alag-alag manuscript versions me substantial differences aa gaye.

qe: In which year did the 14th-century chronicler Ziyauddin Barani complete his first version of the 'Tarikh-i Firuz Shahi'?
qh: 14वीं सदी के इतिहासकार जियाउद्दीन बरनी ने अपना पहला वृत्तांत (Chronicle) कब लिखा था?
e: Barani ne apna first historical chronicle 1356 CE me likha aur iska second revised version 1358 me nikala, jo 1960s tak historians ko pata nahi tha.

qe: Which hydraulic innovation transformed agricultural irrigation in medieval India?
qh: मध्यकाल के दौरान सिंचाई के क्षेत्र में किस नई तकनीक का प्रयोग शुरू हुआ?
e: Persian wheel (Rahat) geared mechanism tha jisse draught animals use karke deep wells se continuously water lift kiya jata tha, transforming irrigation.

qe: During the period 700-1750 CE, to which martial group claiming Kshatriya status did the term 'Rajput' apply?
qh: 700 से 1750 ईस्वी के बीच 'राजपूत' शब्द का महत्व किस समूह के लिए बढ़ा?
o: A collective class of warriors and chieftains claiming Kshatriya descent
e: 'Rajaputra' (son of a king) se derive hua Rajput term 8th-14th century me chivalric warrior class ke liye use hone laga jo heroic martial codes follow karte the.

qe: Why were many forest-dwelling tribes (Vanavasis) compelled to migrate or become settled agrarian peasants during the medieval era?
qh: जंगलों की कटाई के कारण किन लोगों को अपना निवास स्थान छोड़ना पड़ा और वे किसान बन गए?
o: Forest clearance for agricultural expansion disrupted their natural habitat
e: Population badhne se kings ne forests clear karwake agriculture extend kiya, jisse forest dwellers ka habitat khatam hua aur unhe settled peasantry adopt karni padi.

qe: Into what sub-caste social rankings were individuals grouped based on lineage, occupation, and wealth in medieval India?
qh: समाज में बढ़ते अंतर के कारण लोग किन समूहों में बँटने लगे, जिनकी अपनी रस्में और नियम थे?
e: Complex social division me 4 broad varnas ke andar hazaro 'Jatis' (sub-castes) bani jinki social status region aur occupation ke hisaab se vary karti thi.

qe: What was the governing responsibility of the rural 'Jati Panchayat' in medieval society?
qh: 'जाति पंचायत' का मुख्य कार्य क्या था?
o: Enforcing internal behavioral conduct, marriage rules, and customs of its community members
e: Jati Panchayat caste elders ki council hoti thi jo apne jati members ke social behavior, marriage customs aur moral codes ko enforce karti thi.

qe: According to a hyperbolic Sanskrit eulogy (Prashasti), Sultan Ghiyasuddin Balban's empire stretched across which vast territories?
qh: गयासुद्दीन बलबन की संस्कृत प्रशस्ति के अनुसार, उसका साम्राज्य कहाँ से कहाँ तक फैला था?
o: From Gauda (Bengal) in the east to Ghazni (Gajjana in Afghanistan) in the west
e: Sanskrit Prashasti me court poet ne claim kiya ki Balban ka empire east me Gauda (Bengal) se lekar west me Gajjana (Ghazni, Afghanistan) tak faila tha.

qe: Which theological and cultural developments characterized the transformation of Hinduism during the medieval period?
qh: मध्यकाल में हिंदू धर्म में आए प्रमुख परिवर्तनों में से कौन सा एक सही है?
o: Total cessation of all temple building
Worship of new local deities, royal temple construction, and the rise of personal Bhakti
e: Medieval period me local deities ko integrate kiya gaya, grand temple architecture build hui, Brahmin status rise hua aur direct personal Bhakti movement popular hua.

qe: What was the foundational doctrinal schism that historically divided Shia and Sunni Muslims?
qh: इस्लाम धर्म में 'शिया' और 'सुन्नी' के बीच मुख्य मतभेद क्या था?
o: The legitimate succession to Prophet Muhammad (Ali and the Imams vs. the early Caliphs)
The authenticity of the Arabic Quran
e: Shia Muslims Prophet ke son-in-law Ali ko unka rightful divine successor maante the, jabki Sunni community early Caliphs (Abu Bakr, Umar, Uthman) ki political authority accept karti thi.

qe: Into which three periods did 19th-century British colonial historians (like James Mill) divide Indian history?
qh: ब्रिटिश इतिहासकारों ने भारतीय इतिहास को किन तीन कालखंडों में विभाजित किया था?
e: James Mill ne 1817 me rulers ke religion ke basis par Indian history ko 'Hindu Period', 'Muslim Period' aur 'British Period' me divide kiya.

qe: What critical structural defect marred the British periodization of Indian history into 'Hindu' and 'Muslim' periods?
qh: इतिहास में 'युगों' (Periods) का विभाजन करते समय ब्रिटिश इतिहासकारों ने किस महत्वपूर्ण पक्ष की अनदेखी की?
o: They reduced historical evolution solely to the religion of rulers, ignoring profound socio-economic transformations
e: Britishers ne sirf ruling monarch ke religion ko importance di aur hazaro saalo me hue deep economic, agrarian, cultural aur technological developments ko ignore kar diya.

qe: What is an institutional repository where valuable historical manuscripts, charters, and state documents are preserved called?
qh: मध्यकाल में 'पाण्डुलिपियों' को सुरक्षित रखने के स्थान को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: State legal records, treaties, administrative registers aur manuscripts ko safely preserve karne wale place ko 'Archives' (Abhilekhagar) kehte hain.

qe: What primarily motivated the unprecedented physical mobility of people and groups across the subcontinent between 700 and 1750 CE?
qh: 700 से 1750 ईस्वी के इन हजार वर्षों में 'मोबिलिटी' (Mobility) बढ़ने का मुख्य कारण क्या था?
o: The pursuit of abundant agricultural wealth, territorial frontiers, and fortune-building opportunities
e: Indian subcontinent me immense land resources, fertile soil aur wealth thi, isliye groups (jaise Rajputs, pastoralists, traders) fortunes banane ke liye continuously travel karte the.
